"""Metadata-only offline fixtures. No ZIP, CSV, prices, or network are read."""
from copy import deepcopy
import contextlib
from datetime import date
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools" / "audit_download_coverage.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("coverage_audit_tested", SCRIPT)
audit = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(audit)


def fixture_documents():
    documents = {}
    for partition, (start, end) in audit.PERIODS.items():
        records = []
        for symbol in audit.SYMBOLS:
            for month in audit.months_between(start, end):
                filename = f"{symbol}-1d-{month}.zip"
                url = f"{audit.BASE_URL}/{symbol}/1d/{filename}"
                missing = ((partition == "development" and symbol == "SOLUSDT" and month < "2020-08")
                           or (partition == "holdout" and month == "2026-09"))
                record = {"symbol": symbol, "month": month, "partition": partition, "filename": filename,
                          "url": url, "checksum_url": url + ".CHECKSUM",
                          "archive_path": "/MACHINE_PRIVATE/never-open.zip", "checksum_path": "/MACHINE_PRIVATE/never-open.CHECKSUM",
                          "status": "missing_archive" if missing else "verified"}
                if missing:
                    record.update(error_code="http_404", http_status=404)
                else:
                    expected = audit.month_dates(month)
                    observed = [d for d in expected if not (symbol == "SOLUSDT" and d < "2020-08-11")]
                    record.update(sha256="a" * 64, coverage={
                        "rows": len(observed), "first_date": observed[0], "last_date": observed[-1],
                        "expected_start": expected[0], "expected_end": expected[-1], "expected_rows": len(expected),
                        "observed_dates": observed, "missing_dates": sorted(set(expected) - set(observed)),
                        "duplicate_dates": [], "out_of_range_dates": [], "non_midnight_rows": 0,
                        "timestamp_units": ["us" if month >= "2025-01" else "ms"],
                        "schema_scope": "timestamp_only" if partition == "holdout" else "full_kline"})
                records.append(record)
        documents[partition] = {"schema_version": 1, "requested_partition": partition,
                               "requested_start": "2020-01", "requested_end": "2026-09",
                               "complete_requested_range": False, "archive_count": len(records), "records": records}
    return documents


def record_for(documents, partition, symbol, month):
    return next(r for r in documents[partition]["records"] if r["symbol"] == symbol and r["month"] == month)


class CoverageAuditTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.metadata = self.root / "metadata"
        self.metadata.mkdir()
        self.documents = fixture_documents()

    def write_documents(self):
        for partition, document in self.documents.items():
            (self.metadata / audit.METADATA_NAMES[partition]).write_text(json.dumps(document))

    def run_audit(self):
        self.write_documents()
        return audit.audit_metadata(self.metadata)

    def test_official_prelisting_exclusion_does_not_rewrite_raw_failure(self):
        manifest, coverage = self.run_audit()
        dev = coverage["partitions"]["development"]
        self.assertEqual(len(manifest["archives"]), 243)
        self.assertEqual(dev["status_counts"], {"missing_archive": 7, "verified": 137})
        self.assertFalse(dev["raw_complete_requested_range"])
        self.assertFalse(dev["recomputed_raw_requested_range_complete"])
        self.assertTrue(dev["eligible_requested_range_complete"])
        sol = dev["symbols"]["SOLUSDT"]
        self.assertEqual(sol["verified_archives"], 41)
        self.assertEqual(sol["first_observed_date"], "2020-08-11")
        self.assertEqual(sol["confirmed_prelisting_excluded_dates_count"], 223)
        self.assertEqual(sol["confirmed_prelisting_excluded_archive_months"], [f"2020-{n:02d}" for n in range(1, 8)])
        self.assertEqual(sol["missing_eligible_dates"], [])
        original_failure = next(r for r in manifest["archives"] if r["symbol"] == "SOLUSDT" and r["month"] == "2020-01")
        self.assertEqual(original_failure["status"], "missing_archive")
        self.assertIsNone(original_failure["sha256"])
        self.assertIn("partial trading day", coverage["official_prelisting_rule"]["treatment"])

    def test_interior_gap_is_not_excused_as_prelisting(self):
        record = record_for(self.documents, "development", "SOLUSDT", "2021-06")
        record["coverage"]["observed_dates"].remove("2021-06-15")
        record["coverage"]["rows"] -= 1
        record["coverage"]["missing_dates"] = ["2021-06-15"]
        _, coverage = self.run_audit()
        sol = coverage["partitions"]["development"]["symbols"]["SOLUSDT"]
        self.assertEqual(sol["interior_missing_dates"], ["2021-06-15"])
        self.assertEqual(sol["missing_eligible_dates"], ["2021-06-15"])
        self.assertFalse(sol["eligible_requested_range_complete"])
        self.assertFalse(sol["available_interval_contiguous"])

    def test_missing_holdout_tail_stays_incomplete_despite_continuous_available_prefix(self):
        _, coverage = self.run_audit()
        holdout = coverage["partitions"]["holdout"]
        self.assertEqual(holdout["status_counts"], {"missing_archive": 3, "verified": 96})
        self.assertFalse(holdout["eligible_requested_range_complete"])
        self.assertFalse(coverage["all_eligible_requested_ranges_complete"])
        for summary in holdout["symbols"].values():
            self.assertEqual(summary["requested_end"], "2026-09-30")
            self.assertEqual(summary["last_observed_date"], "2026-08-31")
            self.assertEqual(len(summary["missing_eligible_tail_dates"]), 30)
            self.assertTrue(summary["available_from_eligible_start_contiguous"])
            self.assertFalse(summary["eligible_requested_range_complete"])

    def test_plan_requires_all_exact_records_and_unique_asset_month_keys(self):
        original = deepcopy(self.documents)
        changes = [
            lambda d: d["development"]["records"].pop(),
            lambda d: d["development"]["records"].append(deepcopy(d["development"]["records"][0])),
            lambda d: d["development"]["records"][0].update(symbol="OTHER"),
            lambda d: d["development"]["records"][0].update(partition="holdout"),
            lambda d: d["development"].update(archive_count=1),
            lambda d: d["holdout"].update(requested_end="2026-08"),
        ]
        for change in changes:
            with self.subTest(change=change):
                self.documents = deepcopy(original)
                change(self.documents)
                with self.assertRaises(audit.AuditError):
                    self.run_audit()

    def test_observed_dates_detect_duplicates_even_when_declared_summary_is_clean(self):
        record = record_for(self.documents, "development", "BTCUSDT", "2022-03")
        record["coverage"]["observed_dates"].insert(5, "2022-03-05")
        record["coverage"]["rows"] += 1
        manifest, coverage = self.run_audit()
        btc = coverage["partitions"]["development"]["symbols"]["BTCUSDT"]
        self.assertEqual(btc["duplicate_dates"], ["2022-03-05"])
        self.assertFalse(btc["eligible_requested_range_complete"])
        entry = next(r for r in manifest["archives"] if r["symbol"] == "BTCUSDT" and r["month"] == "2022-03")
        self.assertIn("reported_gaps_or_duplicates_disagree_with_observed_dates", entry["audit_issues"])

    def test_failed_record_with_full_dates_never_counts_as_verified(self):
        record = record_for(self.documents, "development", "BTCUSDT", "2022-04")
        record.update(status="failed", error_code="checksum_mismatch")
        manifest, coverage = self.run_audit()
        btc = coverage["partitions"]["development"]["symbols"]["BTCUSDT"]
        self.assertEqual(btc["verified_archives"], 47)
        self.assertEqual(len(btc["missing_eligible_dates"]), 30)
        self.assertFalse(btc["eligible_requested_range_complete"])
        entry = next(r for r in manifest["archives"] if r["symbol"] == "BTCUSDT" and r["month"] == "2022-04")
        self.assertEqual(entry["status"], "failed")

    def test_only_two_metadata_files_read_and_outputs_have_no_machine_paths(self):
        self.write_documents()
        allowed = {self.metadata / name for name in audit.METADATA_NAMES.values()}
        original_bytes = {path: path.read_bytes() for path in allowed}
        read_bytes = Path.read_bytes
        seen = []
        def guarded_read(path):
            self.assertIn(path, allowed, "Only the two metadata files may be read")
            seen.append(path)
            return read_bytes(path)
        output = self.root / "reports"
        with mock.patch.object(Path, "read_bytes", guarded_read), contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            code = audit.main(["--metadata-dir", str(self.metadata), "--output-dir", str(output)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertCountEqual(seen, allowed)
        for name in ["archive_manifest.json", "download_coverage_audit.json"]:
            text = (output / name).read_text()
            self.assertNotIn("MACHINE_PRIVATE", text)
            self.assertNotIn(str(self.metadata), text)
            self.assertNotIn("archive_path", text)
        for path, before in original_bytes.items():
            self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_bad_plan_cli_is_nonzero_and_writes_no_reports(self):
        self.documents["holdout"]["records"].pop()
        self.write_documents()
        output = self.root / "reports"
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            code = audit.main(["--metadata-dir", str(self.metadata), "--output-dir", str(output)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertFalse(output.exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Offline tests: all network access is replaced by byte fixtures."""
import contextlib
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock
import urllib.error
import zipfile

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools" / "download_binance.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tested_binance_downloader", SCRIPT)
dl = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
sys.modules[SPEC.name] = dl
SPEC.loader.exec_module(dl)


def timestamp(day, unit=None):
    unit = unit or ("us" if day >= date(2025, 1, 1) else "ms")
    seconds = int((datetime.combine(day, datetime.min.time(), tzinfo=timezone.utc) - dl.EPOCH).total_seconds())
    return str(seconds * (1_000_000 if unit == "us" else 1000)).encode("ascii")


def row(day, *, unit=None, opaque_holdout=False):
    opening = timestamp(day, unit)
    if opaque_holdout:
        return opening + b",\xff\xfeSEALED_PRICE_DO_NOT_DECODE\n"
    scale = 1_000_000 if (unit or ("us" if day.year >= 2025 else "ms")) == "us" else 1000
    closing = str(int(opening) + 86400 * scale - 1).encode("ascii")
    return b",".join([opening, b"1", b"2", b"0.5", b"1.5", b"2", closing,
                      b"3", b"1", b"1", b"1.5", b"0"]) + b"\n"


def fixture(item, *, omit=(), duplicate=None, opaque_holdout=False, start_day=1, raw=None):
    first, last = dl.month_bounds(item["month"])
    lines = []
    for number in range(start_day, last.day + 1):
        if number in omit:
            continue
        value = row(first.replace(day=number), opaque_holdout=opaque_holdout)
        lines.append(value)
        if number == duplicate:
            lines.append(value)
    payload = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(payload, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        archive.writestr(item["filename"].removesuffix(".zip") + ".csv", b"".join(lines) if raw is None else raw)
    zipped = payload.getvalue()
    checksum = f"{hashlib.sha256(zipped).hexdigest()}  {item['filename']}\n".encode("ascii")
    return {item["url"]: zipped, item["checksum_url"]: checksum}


class DownloadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name) / "data"

    def config(self, **kwargs):
        return dl.DownloadConfig(self.root, start="2020-01", end="2020-01", symbols=("BTCUSDT",), **kwargs)

    def run_fake(self, config, mapping):
        calls, messages = [], []
        def fetch(url):
            calls.append(url)
            value = mapping[url]
            if isinstance(value, Exception):
                raise value
            return value
        code, metadata = dl.run_download(config, fetch=fetch, sleep=lambda _: None, log=messages.append)
        return code, metadata, calls, messages

    def test_default_plan_never_includes_holdout(self):
        plan = dl.build_plan(dl.DownloadConfig(self.root))
        self.assertEqual(len(plan), 3 * 48)
        self.assertEqual(max(i["month"] for i in plan), "2023-12")
        self.assertTrue(all(i["partition"] == "development" for i in plan))
        holdout = dl.build_plan(dl.DownloadConfig(self.root, partition="holdout"))
        self.assertEqual(len(holdout), 3 * 33)
        self.assertEqual(min(i["month"] for i in holdout), "2024-01")

    def test_dry_run_is_read_only_and_fetch_is_never_called(self):
        fetch = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("Network must not run"))
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as output:
            code = dl.main(["--dry-run", "--output-dir", str(self.root)], fetch=fetch)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertFalse(self.root.exists())
        fetch.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue())["counts"], {"development": 144, "holdout": 0})

    def test_checksum_verified_cache_and_development_export(self):
        config = self.config()
        item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
        code, metadata, calls, _ = self.run_fake(config, fixture(item))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)
        exported = (self.root / "development" / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2020-01.csv").read_text()
        self.assertEqual(exported.splitlines()[0], ",".join(dl.CSV_COLUMNS))
        self.assertEqual(len(exported.splitlines()), 32)
        with mock.patch.object(dl, "fetch_url", side_effect=AssertionError("No network")):
            code, cached, calls, _ = self.run_fake(config, {})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])
        self.assertEqual(cached["records"][0]["source"], "cache")
        self.assertEqual(metadata["records"][0]["coverage"]["missing_dates"], [])

    def test_bad_checksum_and_corrupted_cache_fail_before_parsing(self):
        config = self.config()
        item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
        mapping = fixture(item)
        mapping[item["checksum_url"]] = b"0" * 64 + b"  " + item["filename"].encode() + b"\n"
        code, metadata, _, _ = self.run_fake(config, mapping)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(metadata["records"][0]["error_code"], "checksum_mismatch")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "development" / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2020-01.csv").exists())
        self.run_fake(config, fixture(item))
        Path(item["archive_path"]).write_bytes(b"corrupt cached content")
        code, metadata, calls, _ = self.run_fake(config, {})
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])
        self.assertEqual(metadata["records"][0]["error_code"], "checksum_mismatch")

    def test_ms_us_midnight_and_boundary_mismatch(self):
        for day, unit in [(date(2024, 12, 31), "ms"), (date(2025, 1, 1), "us")]:
            self.assertEqual(dl.timestamp_date(timestamp(day, unit)), (day, unit))
        for day, wrong in [(date(2024, 12, 31), "us"), (date(2025, 1, 1), "ms")]:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(dl.SafeFailure, "boundary_mismatch"):
                dl.timestamp_date(timestamp(day, wrong))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(dl.SafeFailure, "non_midnight"):
            dl.timestamp_date(str(int(timestamp(date(2024, 1, 1))) + 1).encode())

    def test_holdout_never_decodes_opaque_price_bytes_or_exports_csv(self):
        config = dl.DownloadConfig(self.root, partition="holdout", start="2025-01", end="2025-01", symbols=("BTCUSDT",))
        item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
        with mock.patch.object(dl, "_development_row", side_effect=AssertionError("Holdout must stay sealed")):
            code, metadata, _, messages = self.run_fake(config, fixture(item, opaque_holdout=True))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(metadata["records"][0]["coverage"]["rows"], 31)
        self.assertEqual(metadata["records"][0]["coverage"]["timestamp_units"], ["us"])
        self.assertFalse(list(self.root.rglob("*.csv")))
        self.assertEqual(metadata["development_csv_outputs"], [])
        self.assertNotIn("SEALED_PRICE", json.dumps(metadata) + " ".join(messages))
        self.assertTrue(Path(item["archive_path"]).is_file())
        self.assertIn("holdout_sealed", item["archive_path"])

    def test_duplicate_missing_day_bad_schema_and_empty_fail(self):
        config = self.config()
        item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
        for options, error in [({"duplicate": 4}, "duplicate_dates"),
                               ({"raw": b""}, "empty_archive"),
                               ({"raw": timestamp(date(2020, 1, 1)) + b",bad\n"}, "invalid_development_schema")]:
            with self.subTest(error=error):
                payload = fixture(item, **options)[item["url"]]
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(dl.SafeFailure, error):
                    dl.scan_archive(payload, item)
        code, metadata, _, _ = self.run_fake(config, fixture(item, omit=(15,)))
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(metadata["symbols"][0]["missing_days_after_first_observation"], ["2020-01-15"])
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "development" / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2020-01.csv").exists())

    def test_sol_leading_404_is_pending_prelisting_but_internal_gap_is_not(self):
        config = dl.DownloadConfig(self.root, start="2020-01", end="2020-02", symbols=("SOLUSDT",))
        first, second = dl.build_plan(config)
        missing = urllib.error.HTTPError(first["url"], 404, "not found", {}, None)
        mapping = {first["url"]: missing, **fixture(second, start_day=10)}
        code, metadata, calls, _ = self.run_fake(config, mapping)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(calls.count(first["url"]), 1)
        summary = metadata["symbols"][0]
        self.assertEqual(summary["leading_missing_months"], ["2020-01"])
        self.assertEqual(summary["prelisting_status"], "possible_prelisting_requires_manual_confirmation")
        self.assertEqual(summary["missing_days_after_first_observation"], [])
        self.assertTrue((self.root / "development" / "SOLUSDT_1d_2020-01_2020-02.csv").is_file())
        payload = fixture(second, start_day=10, omit=(20,))[second["url"]]
        coverage, _ = dl.scan_archive(payload, second)
        summary = dl.summarize_symbol([{"symbol": "SOLUSDT", "month": "2020-01", "partition": "development", "status": "missing_archive"},
            {"symbol": "SOLUSDT", "month": "2020-02", "partition": "development", "status": "verified", "coverage": coverage}])
        self.assertEqual(summary["missing_days_after_first_observation"], ["2020-02-20"])
        self.assertFalse(summary["development_csv_eligible"])

    def test_latest_month_404_has_action_and_nonzero_status(self):
        config = dl.DownloadConfig(self.root, partition="holdout", start="2026-09", end="2026-09", symbols=("BTCUSDT",))
        item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
        code, metadata, calls, messages = self.run_fake(config, {
            item["url"]: urllib.error.HTTPError(item["url"], 404, "not found", {}, None)})
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertIn("2026-10-05", metadata["records"][0]["action"])
        self.assertIn("does not implement", " ".join(messages))

    def test_network_errors_retry_but_exhaustion_is_safe(self):
        waits = []
        fetch = mock.Mock(side_effect=[urllib.error.URLError("secret server text"), b"ok"])
        self.assertEqual(dl.fetch_with_retry("fixture", fetch, retries=3, backoff=.5, sleep=waits.append), b"ok")
        self.assertEqual(waits, [.5])
        fetch = mock.Mock(side_effect=urllib.error.URLError("secret server text"))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(dl.SafeFailure, "^network_error$"):
            dl.fetch_with_retry("fixture", fetch, retries=2, backoff=0, sleep=lambda _: None)
        self.assertEqual(fetch.call_count, 2)

    def test_missing_checksum_is_not_prelisting_and_wrong_filename_fails(self):
        config = self.config()
        item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
        mapping = fixture(item)
        mapping[item["checksum_url"]] = urllib.error.HTTPError(item["checksum_url"], 404, "missing", {}, None)
        code, metadata, _, _ = self.run_fake(config, mapping)

        self.assertEqual(metadata["records"][0]["error_code"], "checksum_unavailable")
        self.assertEqual(metadata["symbols"][0]["leading_missing_months"], [])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(dl.SafeFailure, "invalid_checksum_format"):
            dl.checksum_digest(b"0" * 64 + b"  other.zip", item["filename"])

    def test_small_range_export_preserves_existing_full_development_csv(self):
        full_config = dl.DownloadConfig(self.root, symbols=("BTCUSDT",))
        mapping = {}
        for item in dl.build_plan(full_config):
            mapping.update(fixture(item))
        code, metadata, _, _ = self.run_fake(full_config, mapping)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        full_path = self.root / "development" / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2023-12.csv"
        original = full_path.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(len(original.splitlines()), 1462)
        self.assertEqual(metadata["development_csv_outputs"], [str(full_path.resolve())])

        # January is cached: a narrow rerun writes its own file without fetching.
        code, metadata, calls, _ = self.run_fake(self.config(), {})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])
        narrow_path = self.root / "development" / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2020-01.csv"
        self.assertEqual(len(narrow_path.read_bytes().splitlines()), 32)
        self.assertEqual(metadata["development_csv_outputs"], [str(narrow_path.resolve())])

    def test_partition_symlink_is_rejected_before_fetch_or_cache_read(self):
        development = self.root / "development"
        development.mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.root / "holdout_sealed").symlink_to(development, target_is_directory=True)
        config = dl.DownloadConfig(self.root, partition="holdout", start="2025-01", end="2025-01", symbols=("BTCUSDT",))
        fetch = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("Must reject before network"))
        with mock.patch.object(Path, "read_bytes", side_effect=AssertionError("Must reject before cache reads")):
            code, metadata = dl.run_download(config, fetch=fetch, log=lambda _: None)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(metadata["error_code"], "unsafe_output_path")
        fetch.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(list(development.iterdir()), [])
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "metadata").exists())

    def test_cache_checksum_csv_and_metadata_symlinks_are_rejected_before_fetch(self):
        cases = ("archive", "checksum", "csv", "metadata", "archives")
        for target in cases:
            with self.subTest(target=target):
                root = Path(self.temporary.name) / target
                config = dl.DownloadConfig(root, start="2020-01", end="2020-01", symbols=("BTCUSDT",))
                item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
                outside = Path(self.temporary.name) / (target + "_outside")
                if target in {"metadata", "archives"}:
                    outside.mkdir()
                    path = root / "metadata" if target == "metadata" else root / "development" / "archives"
                else:
                    outside.write_bytes(b"outside data must not be read")
                    path = {"archive": Path(item["archive_path"]),
                            "checksum": Path(item["checksum_path"]),
                            "csv": root / "development" / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2020-01.csv"}[target]
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=target in {"metadata", "archives"})
                fetch = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("Must reject before network"))
                with mock.patch.object(Path, "read_bytes", side_effect=AssertionError("Must reject before cache reads")):
                    code, metadata = dl.run_download(config, fetch=fetch, log=lambda _: None)
                self.assertEqual(code, 1)
                self.assertEqual(metadata["error_code"], "unsafe_output_path")
                fetch.assert_not_called()

    def test_output_root_itself_may_be_a_symlink(self):
        actual = Path(self.temporary.name) / "actual_root"
        actual.mkdir()
        self.root.symlink_to(actual, target_is_directory=True)
        config = self.config()
        item = dl.build_plan(config)[0]
        code, metadata, _, _ = self.run_fake(config, fixture(item))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        expected = actual / "development" / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2020-01.csv"
        self.assertTrue(expected.is_file())
        self.assertEqual(metadata["development_csv_outputs"], [str(expected.resolve())])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Focused synthetic checks for the reusable research math; no data files read."""
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import product
from math import prod
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path


def _load_notebook_functions():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    if not (root / "notebooks/01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb").exists():
        root = root / "prepared"
    notebook_path = root / "notebooks" / "01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb"
    notebook = json.loads(notebook_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected = {
        "_validate_daily_index",
        "count_transitions",
        "estimate_transition_matrix",
        "count_lagged_transitions",
        "ck_statistic",
        "simulate_markov_paths",
        "ck_bootstrap",
    }
    trees, names = [], set()
    for index, cell in enumerate(notebook["cells"]):
        if cell.get("cell_type") != "code" or "research-functions" not in cell.get("metadata", {}).get("tags", []):
            continue
        source = cell.get("source", [])
        source = source if isinstance(source, str) else "".join(source)
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=f"{notebook_path}#cell-{index}")
        for node in tree.body:
            if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
                raise ValueError("research-functions cells must contain only function definitions")
            if node.name in names:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate notebook function: {node.name}")
            names.add(node.name)
        trees.append((index, tree))
    if not expected.issubset(names):
        raise ValueError(f"Missing notebook functions: {sorted(expected - names)}")
    # Validate the entire tagged set before executing any definition. Loading and
    # analysis cells are never compiled or executed by this test loader.
    namespace = {"np": np, "pd": pd}
    for index, tree in trees:
        exec(compile(tree, f"{notebook_path}#cell-{index}", "exec"), namespace)
    return {name: namespace[name] for name in expected}


globals().update(_load_notebook_functions())


def daily(values, *, start="2020-01-01", dtype=None, tz=None):
    return pd.Series(values, index=pd.date_range(start, periods=len(values), freq="D", tz=tz), dtype=dtype)


def closes(n=70):
    returns = np.resize(np.array([0.01, -0.02, 0.015, -0.005, 0.025]), n - 1)
    return daily(np.r_[100.0, 100.0 * np.cumprod(1 + returns)])


class RawTransitionMLETests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_raw_row_mle_is_not_smoothed_and_invalid_count_matrices_fail(self):
        counts = np.array([[1, 2, 0], [2, 1, 1], [0, 1, 1]])
        expected = np.array([[1 / 3, 2 / 3, 0], [1 / 2, 1 / 4, 1 / 4], [0, 1 / 2, 1 / 2]])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(estimate_transition_matrix(counts), expected)
        for invalid in [np.ones((2, 3)), np.ones((3, 4)),
                        np.array([[0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]]),
                        np.array([[-1, 2, 2], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]]),
                        np.array([[0.5, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]]),
                        np.full((3, 3), np.nan), np.full((3, 3), np.inf)]:
            with self.subTest(counts=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    estimate_transition_matrix(invalid)



class ChapmanKolmogorovTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_five_day_counts_match_manual_endpoint_pairs_in_correct_direction(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 2, 2], dtype="Int64")
        # The five endpoint pairs are 0->1, 1->0, 2->1, 0->2, 2->2.
        counts = count_lagged_transitions(states, lag=5)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(counts, [[0, 1, 1], [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 1]])
        self.assertTrue(np.issubdtype(counts.dtype, np.integer))
        self.assertEqual(int(counts.sum()), 5)

    def test_full_year_counts_use_n_minus_lag_overlapping_pairs(self):
        states = daily(np.arange(365) % 3, dtype="Int64", tz="UTC")
        one_step = count_lagged_transitions(states, lag=1)
        five_step = count_lagged_transitions(states, lag=5)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(one_step, count_transitions(states))
        self.assertEqual(int(one_step.sum()), 364)
        self.assertEqual(int(five_step.sum()), 360)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(five_step, [[0, 0, 120], [120, 0, 0], [0, 120, 0]])

    def test_lag_counts_reject_bad_lags_missing_states_and_discontinuous_indexes(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2], dtype="Int64")
        for lag in [0, -1, 6, 7, 1.5, True, False, "5"]:
            with self.subTest(lag=lag):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    count_lagged_transitions(states, lag=lag)
        for invalid in [pd.NA, np.nan, np.inf, -1, 3, 0.5, "invalid"]:
            with self.subTest(state=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    count_lagged_transitions(daily([0, 1, invalid, 2, 1, 0]), lag=5)
        base = states.index
        indexes = [base.delete(2).append(pd.DatetimeIndex([base[-1] + pd.Timedelta(days=1)])),
                   pd.DatetimeIndex([base[0], base[0], *base[2:]]),
                   base[::-1], base + pd.Timedelta(hours=12), pd.RangeIndex(6)]
        for index in indexes:
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    count_lagged_transitions(pd.Series(states.to_numpy(), index=index), lag=5)

    def test_deterministic_cycle_has_zero_discrepancy_and_bootstrap_p_one(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2] * 12, dtype="Int64")
        observed = ck_statistic(states)
        transition = np.array([[0., 1., 0.], [0., 0., 1.], [1., 0., 0.]])
        power_five = np.array([[0., 0., 1.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 1., 0.]])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed["P1"], transition)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed["P_lag"], power_five)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed["P_power"], power_five)
        self.assertEqual(observed["statistic"], 0.0)
        result = ck_bootstrap(states, n_simulations=7, seed=123)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["simulated_statistics"], np.zeros(7))
        self.assertEqual(result["invalid_simulations"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["exceedances"], 7)  # Ties count as exceedances.
        self.assertEqual(result["p_value"], 1.0)

    def test_empty_lag_source_rows_have_nan_probabilities_and_zero_weight(self):
        states = daily([0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 0], dtype="Int64")
        result = ck_statistic(states, lag=5)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["counts_lag"], [[1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["source_weights"], [1., 0., 0.])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["P_lag"][0], [1., 0., 0.])
        self.assertTrue(np.isnan(result["P_lag"][1:]).all())
        p_one = np.array([[2 / 3, 1 / 3, 0.], [0., 0., 1.], [1., 0., 0.]])
        expected = float(np.square(np.array([1., 0., 0.]) - np.linalg.matrix_power(p_one, 5)[0]).sum())
        self.assertTrue(np.isfinite(result["statistic"]))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["statistic"], expected, places=14)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(result["statistic"], 0.0)
        self.assertLessEqual(result["statistic"], 2.0)

    def test_unobserved_one_step_source_row_makes_statistic_undefined(self):
        # State 2 exists only at the final observation and has no outgoing pair.
        states = daily([0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 2], dtype="Int64")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ck_statistic(states, lag=5)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ck_bootstrap(states, lag=5, n_simulations=3)

    def test_simulation_matches_independent_seeded_inverse_cdf_and_fixed_initial_state(self):
        matrix = np.array([[.25, .5, .25], [.1, .2, .7], [.65, .25, .1]])
        seed, n_paths, length, initial = 17, 7, 10, 1
        uniforms = np.random.default_rng(seed).random((n_paths, length - 1))
        expected = np.full((n_paths, length), initial, dtype=int)
        for path in range(n_paths):
            for step in range(1, length):
                cumulative = np.cumsum(matrix[expected[path, step - 1]])
                cumulative[-1] = 1.0
                expected[path, step] = np.searchsorted(cumulative, uniforms[path, step - 1], side="right")
        actual = simulate_markov_paths(matrix, initial, length, n_paths, seed=seed)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, simulate_markov_paths(matrix, initial, length, n_paths, seed=seed))
        self.assertTrue(np.issubdtype(actual.dtype, np.integer))
        self.assertTrue(np.isin(actual, [0, 1, 2]).all())
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[:, 0], [initial] * n_paths)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(simulate_markov_paths(matrix, 2, 1, 4, seed=0), [[2]] * 4)

    def test_simulation_validates_probability_matrix_and_integer_parameters(self):
        valid = np.array([[.2, .5, .3], [.1, .8, .1], [.4, .3, .3]])
        invalid_matrices = [np.ones((2, 2)), np.ones((3, 3)), np.full((3, 3), np.nan),
                            np.full((3, 3), np.inf),
                            np.array([[-.1, .6, .5], [.1, .8, .1], [.4, .3, .3]])]
        for matrix in invalid_matrices:
            with self.subTest(matrix=matrix):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    simulate_markov_paths(matrix, 0, 10, 3)
        for parameter, invalid_values in {
            "length": [0, -1, 1.5, True, "10"],
            "n_paths": [0, -1, 1.5, True, "3"],
            "initial_state": [-1, 3, 0.5, True, "1"],
            "seed": [-1, 1.5, True, "17"],
        }.items():
            for value in invalid_values:
                arguments = dict(initial_state=0, length=10, n_paths=3, seed=17)
                arguments[parameter] = value
                with self.subTest(parameter=parameter, value=value):
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        simulate_markov_paths(valid, **arguments)

    def test_bootstrap_matches_independent_reestimation_on_every_simulated_path(self):
        states = daily([0, 0, 1, 2, 1, 0, 2, 2, 0, 1, 1, 2] * 10, dtype="Int64")
        lag, n_simulations, seed = 5, 11, 1234

        def manual_statistic(sequence):
            matrices = []
            for distance in [1, lag]:
                counts = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=int)
                for origin, destination in zip(sequence[:-distance], sequence[distance:]):
                    counts[int(origin), int(destination)] += 1
                matrices.append(counts)
            one, later = matrices
            p_one = one / one.sum(axis=1)[:, None]
            p_power = np.eye(3)
            for _ in range(lag):
                p_power = p_power @ p_one
            total = 0.0
            for row in range(3):
                source_count = later[row].sum()
                if source_count:
                    row_probability = later[row] / source_count
                    total += (source_count / later.sum()) * sum(
                        (float(row_probability[column]) - float(p_power[row, column])) ** 2
                        for column in range(3))
            return float(total), p_one, one, later

        observed_statistic, fitted, one, later = manual_statistic(states.to_numpy())
        paths = simulate_markov_paths(fitted, int(states.iloc[0]), len(states), n_simulations, seed=seed)
        expected = np.array([manual_statistic(path)[0] for path in paths])
        result = ck_bootstrap(states, lag=lag, n_simulations=n_simulations, seed=seed)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["observed"]["counts_1"], one)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["observed"]["counts_lag"], later)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["observed"]["statistic"], observed_statistic, places=14)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["simulated_statistics"], expected, atol=1e-14, rtol=1e-12)
        self.assertTrue(((expected >= 0) & (expected <= 2)).all())
        exceedances = int(np.count_nonzero(expected >= observed_statistic))
        self.assertEqual(result["exceedances"], exceedances)
        self.assertEqual(result["p_value"], (1 + exceedances) / (n_simulations + 1))
        self.assertEqual(result["invalid_simulations"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["n_simulations"], n_simulations)
        self.assertEqual(result["seed"], seed)
        repeat = ck_bootstrap(states, lag=lag, n_simulations=n_simulations, seed=seed)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["simulated_statistics"], repeat["simulated_statistics"])

    def test_any_invalid_simulation_withholds_p_value_without_deleting_or_redrawing(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2] * 4, dtype="Int64")
        fixed_paths = np.array([states.to_numpy(dtype=int), np.zeros(len(states), dtype=int)])
        simulator = Mock(return_value=fixed_paths)
        with patch.dict(ck_bootstrap.__globals__, {"simulate_markov_paths": simulator}):
            result = ck_bootstrap(states, n_simulations=2, seed=77)
        simulator.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(result["n_simulations"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["invalid_simulations"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["simulated_statistics"].shape, (2,))
        self.assertEqual(result["simulated_statistics"][0], 0.0)
        self.assertTrue(np.isnan(result["simulated_statistics"][1]))
        self.assertTrue(np.isnan(result["p_value"]))
        self.assertIsNone(result["exceedances"])

    def test_bootstrap_rejects_invalid_simulation_counts_and_seeds(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2] * 4, dtype="Int64")
        for parameter, invalid_values in {
            "n_simulations": [0, -1, 1.5, True, "3"],
            "seed": [-1, 1.5, True, "17"],
        }.items():
            for value in invalid_values:
                arguments = dict(n_simulations=3, seed=17)
                arguments[parameter] = value
                with self.subTest(parameter=parameter, value=value):
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        ck_bootstrap(states, **arguments)



if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Synthetic gate tests: temporary Git repositories and ZIPs; no live network."""
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock
import urllib.error
import zipfile

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools" / "part_a_gate.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tested_part_a_gate", SCRIPT)
gate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(gate)
OCT3 = datetime(2026, 10, 3, 17, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
OCT7 = datetime(2026, 10, 7, 17, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
OCT8 = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 17, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def function_source(*, fail=False):
    if fail:
        return "def evaluate_asset(close, origin_start, origin_end, config):\n    raise RuntimeError('synthetic failure')\n"
    return '''def evaluate_asset(close, origin_start, origin_end, config):
    output = {name: pd.DataFrame({'origin_end': [origin_end]}) for name in %s}
    output['forecasts']['exclusion_reason'] = ''
    output['daily_losses']['score_exclusion_reason'] = ''
    output['summary'] = pd.DataFrame({'brier': [0.2, 0.2, 0.2], 'n': [1, 1, 1]}, index=['markov','pooled','state'])
    output['comparisons'] = pd.DataFrame({'delta_brier': [0.,0.,0.], 'ci_lower': [-.1,-.1,-.1],
        'ci_upper': [.1,.1,.1], 'decision': ['uncertain','uncertain','uncertain']},
        index=['markov_vs_state','markov_vs_pooled','state_vs_pooled'])
    return output
''' % (repr(gate.OUTPUTS),)


def synthetic_archive(symbol, month, *, opaque=False, omit=None, wrong_unit=False):
    first = date.fromisoformat(month + "-01")
    following = date(first.year + (first.month == 12), first.month % 12 + 1, 1)
    start = max(first, date(2020, 8, 11)) if symbol == "SOLUSDT" and month == "2020-08" else first
    rows = []
    for text in gate._days(start, following - gate.timedelta(days=1)):
        if text == omit:
            continue
        day = date.fromisoformat(text)
        us = day >= date(2025, 1, 1)
        if wrong_unit:
            us = not us
        multiplier = 86_400_000_000 if us else 86_400_000
        timestamp = str((day - date(1970, 1, 1)).days * multiplier).encode()
        suffix = b",\xffSEALED_NO_DECODE\n" if opaque else b",1,2,0.5,1.5,1,0,1,1,1,1,0\n"
        rows.append(timestamp + suffix)
    filename, _, _ = gate._archive_identity(symbol, month)
    out = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        archive.writestr(filename[:-4] + ".csv", b"".join(rows))
    payload = out.getvalue()
    checksum = (hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() + "  " + filename + "\n").encode()
    return payload, checksum


class PartAGateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(directory.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(directory.name)
        for name in gate.PROTECTED:
            path = self.root / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_text("synthetic protected input\n")
        shutil.copyfile(SCRIPT, self.root / "tools/part_a_gate.py")
        (self.root / gate.CONFIG).write_text("{}\n")
        self.write_notebook()
        self.git("init", "-q")
        self.git("config", "user.email", "synthetic@example.invalid")
        self.git("config", "user.name", "Synthetic Test")
        self.git("add", ".")
        self.git("commit", "-qm", "synthetic starting inputs")
        gate.freeze(self.root, clock=lambda: OCT3)
        self.git("add", gate.MANIFEST)
        self.git("commit", "-qm", "synthetic Part A freeze")
        self.commit = self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()

    def git(self, *args):
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(self.root), *args], stderr=subprocess.PIPE).decode()

    def write_notebook(self, *, source=None, other="raise RuntimeError('untagged must never run')"):
        path = self.root / gate.NOTEBOOK
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"cells": [
            {"cell_type": "code", "metadata": {"tags": [gate.TAG]}, "source": source or function_source()},
            {"cell_type": "code", "metadata": {}, "source": other}]}))

    def populate_inputs(self, *, end="2026-08-31", opaque=False):
        for symbol in gate.ASSETS:
            first = date(2020, 8, 1) if symbol == "SOLUSDT" else date(2020, 1, 1)
            for month in gate._months(first, date.fromisoformat(end)):
                _, relative, _ = gate._archive_identity(symbol, month)
                payload, checksum = synthetic_archive(symbol, month, opaque=opaque)
                path = self.root / relative
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_bytes(payload)
                Path(str(path) + ".CHECKSUM").write_bytes(checksum)

    def fetch_fixture(self, *, missing=(), bad_checksum=(), missing_checksum=(), gaps=(), opaque=False):
        fixtures = {}
        for symbol in gate.ASSETS:
            _, _, url = gate._archive_identity(symbol, "2026-09")
            if symbol in missing:
                fixtures[url] = urllib.error.HTTPError(url, 404, "synthetic missing", {}, None)
            else:
                payload, checksum = synthetic_archive(symbol, "2026-09", opaque=opaque,
                    omit="2026-09-15" if symbol in gaps else None)
                fixtures[url] = payload
                if symbol in bad_checksum:
                    checksum = b"0" * 64 + b"  " + f"{symbol}-1d-2026-09.zip".encode()
                if symbol in missing_checksum:
                    checksum = urllib.error.HTTPError(url, 404, "synthetic missing checksum", {}, None)
                fixtures[url + ".CHECKSUM"] = checksum
        def fetch(url):
            value = fixtures[url]
            if isinstance(value, Exception):
                raise value
            return value
        return fetch

    def lock(self, **kwargs):
        return gate.lock_calendar(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT7, fetch=self.fetch_fixture(**kwargs))

    def test_freeze_and_dry_check_read_no_archives_or_analysis_cells(self):
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "preflight_inputs", side_effect=AssertionError("no archive read")):
            result = gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)
            namespace = gate.load_part_a_functions(self.root)
        self.assertEqual(result["frozen_commit"], self.commit)
        self.assertIn("evaluate_asset", namespace)
        self.assertNotIn("close", namespace)

    def test_only_function_definitions_with_no_definition_time_side_effects(self):
        for source in ["x = 1\n" + function_source(),
                       "@print('bad')\n" + function_source(),
                       "def bad(x=print('bad')):\n    pass\n" + function_source()]:
            with self.subTest(source=source):
                self.write_notebook(source=source)
                with self.assertRaises(gate.GateError):
                    gate.load_part_a_functions(self.root)

    def test_part_b_only_working_and_committed_changes_are_allowed(self):
        self.write_notebook(other="# new Part B diagnostic\nraise RuntimeError('still not run')")
        (self.root / "research/part_b_notes.md").write_text("New Part B notes")
        gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)
        self.git("add", gate.NOTEBOOK, "research/part_b_notes.md")
        self.git("commit", "-qm", "continue Part B")
        checked = gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)
        self.assertNotEqual(checked["head_commit"], self.commit)

    def test_protected_file_and_function_projection_drift_are_refused(self):
        config = self.root / gate.CONFIG
        before = config.read_bytes()
        config.write_text('{"changed":true}')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "drifted"):
            gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)
        config.write_bytes(before)
        self.write_notebook(source=function_source() + "\n# changed Part A projection\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "projection"):
            gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)

    def test_freeze_versions_are_recorded_and_runtime_drift_is_refused(self):
        manifest = json.loads((self.root / gate.MANIFEST).read_text())
        self.assertEqual(manifest["created_chicago_date"], "2026-10-03")
        self.assertTrue(all(name in manifest["environment"] for name in ["python", "numpy", "pandas"]))
        self.assertIn("tests/test_part_a_shared.py", manifest["protected_sha256"])
        self.assertNotIn("tests/test_markov.py", manifest["protected_sha256"])
        changed = gate._environment()
        changed["numpy"] = "synthetic_drift"
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "_environment", return_value=changed):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "environment"):
                gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)

    def test_manifest_mutation_and_nonancestor_commit_are_refused(self):
        manifest = self.root / gate.MANIFEST
        before = manifest.read_bytes()
        manifest.write_bytes(before + b"\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "manifest"):
            gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)
        manifest.write_bytes(before)
        self.git("checkout", "--orphan", "unrelated")
        self.git("add", ".")
        self.git("commit", "-qm", "unrelated history")
        with self.assertRaises(gate.GateError):
            gate.verify_freeze(self.root, self.commit)

    def test_early_date_and_late_calendar_lock_refuse_before_price_or_network_read(self):
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "_read_close", side_effect=AssertionError("price read")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "before"):
                gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT3)
        for clock in [lambda: OCT3, lambda: OCT8]:
            fetch = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("network"))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "only on"):
                gate.lock_calendar(self.root, self.commit, clock=clock, fetch=fetch)
            fetch.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY).exists())

    def test_ms_us_units_and_timestamp_only_checks(self):
        for month, unit in [("2024-12", "ms"), ("2025-01", "us")]:
            payload, checksum = synthetic_archive("BTCUSDT", month, opaque=True)
            info = gate.inspect_archive(payload, checksum, "BTCUSDT", month)
            self.assertEqual(info["timestamp_units"], [unit])
        payload, checksum = synthetic_archive("BTCUSDT", "2025-01", wrong_unit=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "unit"):
            gate.inspect_archive(payload, checksum, "BTCUSDT", "2025-01")

    def test_fresh_archive_404_locks_shared_august_end_without_decoding_prices(self):
        self.populate_inputs(opaque=True)
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "_read_close", side_effect=AssertionError("price read")):
            decision = self.lock(missing=("ETHUSDT",), opaque=True)
        self.assertEqual(decision["label_end"], "2026-08-31")
        self.assertEqual(decision["origin_end"], "2026-08-26")
        self.assertEqual(len(decision["input_archives"]), 233)
        self.assertTrue(all(entry["month"] <= "2026-08" for entry in decision["input_archives"]))
        self.assertEqual({entry["symbol"] for entry in decision["input_archives"]}, set(gate.ASSETS))
        self.assertFalse((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY).exists())
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "already exists"):
            self.lock(missing=("ETHUSDT",), opaque=True)

    def test_available_september_locks_full_shared_interval(self):
        self.populate_inputs(opaque=True)
        decision = self.lock(opaque=True)
        self.assertFalse(decision["fallback"])
        self.assertEqual(decision["label_end"], "2026-09-30")
        self.assertEqual(decision["origin_end"], "2026-09-25")
        self.assertEqual(len(decision["input_archives"]), 236)

    def test_bad_checksum_is_not_missing_archive_fallback_and_attempt_is_retained(self):
        self.populate_inputs(opaque=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "checksum"):
            self.lock(bad_checksum=("BTCUSDT",), missing=("ETHUSDT",), opaque=True)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / gate.CALENDAR_RECORD).exists())
        attempts = list((self.root / "results/part_a_calendar_attempts").glob("*.json"))
        self.assertEqual(len(attempts), 1)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(attempts[0].read_text())["status"], "failed")

    def test_missing_checksum_and_calendar_gaps_do_not_activate_fallback(self):
        self.populate_inputs(opaque=True)
        for kwargs in [{"missing_checksum": ("BTCUSDT",)}, {"gaps": ("BTCUSDT",)}]:
            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs):
                with self.assertRaises(gate.GateError):
                    self.lock(**kwargs, missing=("ETHUSDT",), opaque=True)
                self.assertFalse((self.root / gate.CALENDAR_RECORD).exists())

    def test_missing_older_archive_aborts_before_september_probe(self):
        self.populate_inputs(opaque=True)
        _, relative, _ = gate._archive_identity("BTCUSDT", "2024-02")
        (self.root / relative).unlink()
        fetch = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("must not fetch"))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "required input"):
            gate.lock_calendar(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT7, fetch=fetch)
        fetch.assert_not_called()

    def test_delayed_evaluation_requires_existing_october7_decision(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "decision is required"):
            gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT8)

    def test_atomic_claim_precedes_price_read_all_outputs_saved_and_repeat_refused(self):
        self.populate_inputs()
        self.lock(missing=gate.ASSETS)
        original = gate._read_close
        calls = []
        def checked_read(root, entries, symbol):
            status = json.loads((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / "status.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(status["status"], "running")
            self.assertTrue((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / "input_archives.json").exists())
            calls.append(symbol)
            return original(root, entries, symbol)
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "_read_close", checked_read):
            result = gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT8)
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "completed")
        self.assertEqual(calls, list(gate.ASSETS))
        for symbol in gate.ASSETS:
            for output in gate.OUTPUTS:
                self.assertTrue((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / symbol / (output + ".csv")).is_file())
            self.assertTrue((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / symbol / "exclusion_counts.csv").is_file())
        report = (self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / "report.md").read_text()
        self.assertIn("fallback was activated", report)
        self.assertIn("uncertain", report)
        self.assertIn("2026-08-26", report)
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "_read_close", side_effect=AssertionError("repeat price read")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "already exists"):
                gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT8)

    def test_post_lock_input_change_fails_without_prices_and_retains_run(self):
        self.populate_inputs()
        self.lock(missing=gate.ASSETS)
        _, relative, _ = gate._archive_identity("BTCUSDT", "2024-01")
        (self.root / relative).write_bytes(b"corrupted synthetic archive")
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "_read_close", side_effect=AssertionError("price read")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "checksum"):
                gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT8)
        status = json.loads((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / "status.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(status["status"], "failed")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "already exists"):
            gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT8)

    def test_model_failure_retains_run_and_cannot_be_retried(self):
        self.populate_inputs()
        self.lock(missing=gate.ASSETS)
        def fail(*args):
            raise RuntimeError("synthetic exception after price access")
        import pandas as pd
        with mock.patch.object(gate, "load_part_a_functions", return_value={"pd": pd, "evaluate_asset": fail}):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT8)
        status = json.loads((self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / "status.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(status["status"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(status["error_type"], "RuntimeError")
        self.assertIn("synthetic exception", (self.root / gate.RUN_DIRECTORY / "traceback.txt").read_text())
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateError, "already exists"):
            gate.evaluate(self.root, self.commit, clock=lambda: OCT8)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Focused synthetic checks for the reusable research math; no data files read."""
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import product
from math import prod
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path


def _load_notebook_functions():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    if not (root / "notebooks/01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb").exists():
        root = root / "prepared"
    notebook_path = root / "notebooks" / "01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb"
    notebook = json.loads(notebook_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected = {
        "_validate_daily_index",
        "classify_states",
        "make_features",
        "count_transitions",
        "first_passage_probabilities",
        "make_event_labels",
    }
    trees, names = [], set()
    for index, cell in enumerate(notebook["cells"]):
        if cell.get("cell_type") != "code" or "part-a-functions" not in cell.get("metadata", {}).get("tags", []):
            continue
        source = cell.get("source", [])
        source = source if isinstance(source, str) else "".join(source)
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=f"{notebook_path}#cell-{index}")
        for node in tree.body:
            if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
                raise ValueError("part-a-functions cells must contain only function definitions")
            if node.name in names:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate notebook function: {node.name}")
            names.add(node.name)
        trees.append((index, tree))
    if not expected.issubset(names):
        raise ValueError(f"Missing notebook functions: {sorted(expected - names)}")
    # Validate the entire tagged set before executing any definition. Loading and
    # analysis cells are never compiled or executed by this test loader.
    namespace = {"np": np, "pd": pd}
    for index, tree in trees:
        exec(compile(tree, f"{notebook_path}#cell-{index}", "exec"), namespace)
    return {name: namespace[name] for name in expected}


globals().update(_load_notebook_functions())


def daily(values, *, start="2020-01-01", dtype=None, tz=None):
    return pd.Series(values, index=pd.date_range(start, periods=len(values), freq="D", tz=tz), dtype=dtype)


def closes(n=70):
    returns = np.resize(np.array([0.01, -0.02, 0.015, -0.005, 0.025]), n - 1)
    return daily(np.r_[100.0, 100.0 * np.cumprod(1 + returns)])


class MarkovTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_state_boundaries_and_nonfinite_values(self):
        z = daily([-np.inf, -1.01, -1.0, -0.999, 0.0, 0.999, 1.0, 1.01, np.inf, np.nan])
        actual = classify_states(z)
        expected = pd.Series([pd.NA, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, pd.NA, pd.NA],
                             index=z.index, dtype="Int64", name="state")
        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)

    def test_returns_strict_previous_twenty_sample_std_and_first_valid_date(self):
        close = closes()
        features = make_features(close)
        self.assertEqual(list(features.columns), ["close", "ret", "sigma", "z", "state"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(features["ret"].iloc[1], close.iloc[1] / close.iloc[0] - 1)
        expected = np.std(features["ret"].iloc[1:21].to_numpy(), ddof=1)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(features["sigma"].iloc[21], expected)
        self.assertFalse(np.isclose(expected, np.std(features["ret"].iloc[1:21], ddof=0)))
        self.assertTrue(features["sigma"].iloc[:21].isna().all())
        self.assertEqual(features["state"].first_valid_index(), pd.Timestamp("2020-01-22"))

    def test_future_prices_do_not_change_past_features_or_current_sigma(self):
        original = closes()
        changed = original.copy()
        cutoff = original.index[35]
        changed.loc[cutoff:] *= 1.5
        first, second = make_features(original), make_features(changed)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(first.loc[first.index < cutoff], second.loc[second.index < cutoff])
        self.assertEqual(first.at[cutoff, "sigma"], second.at[cutoff, "sigma"])
        self.assertNotEqual(first.at[cutoff, "ret"], second.at[cutoff, "ret"])

    def test_missing_close_is_not_forward_filled_and_invalidates_required_window(self):
        close = closes()
        close.iloc[25] = np.nan
        result = make_features(close)
        self.assertTrue(result["ret"].iloc[25:27].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(result["state"].iloc[25:47].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(result["sigma"].iloc[26:47].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(pd.notna(result["sigma"].iloc[47]))

    def test_zero_volatility_leaves_states_unavailable(self):
        result = make_features(daily([100.0] * 45))
        self.assertTrue(result["sigma"].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(result["z"].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(result["state"].isna().all())

    def test_invalid_nonmissing_close_values_are_rejected(self):
        for invalid in [0.0, -1.0, np.inf, -np.inf]:
            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid):
                close = closes()
                close.iloc[30] = invalid
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    make_features(close)

    def test_features_and_transition_counting_require_a_complete_daily_index(self):
        base = pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=3, freq="D")
        invalid_indexes = {
            "duplicate": pd.DatetimeIndex([base[0], base[0], base[2]]),
            "unsorted": pd.DatetimeIndex([base[1], base[0], base[2]]),
            "gap": pd.DatetimeIndex([base[0], base[1], base[2] + pd.Timedelta(days=1)]),
            "not_midnight": base + pd.Timedelta(hours=12),
            "not_datetime": pd.RangeIndex(3),
            "non_utc_midnight": pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=3, tz="America/New_York"),
        }
        for name, index in invalid_indexes.items():
            with self.subTest(index=name, operation="features"):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    make_features(pd.Series([100.0, 101.0, 99.0], index=index))
            with self.subTest(index=name, operation="transitions"):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    count_transitions(pd.Series([0, 1, 2], index=index))

    def test_utc_daily_index_is_accepted_without_changing_dates(self):
        close = closes()
        close.index = close.index.tz_localize("UTC")
        result = make_features(close)
        self.assertTrue(result.index.equals(close.index))
        actual = count_transitions(daily([0, 1, 2], tz="UTC"))
        expected = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=int)
        expected[0, 1], expected[1, 2] = 1, 1
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)

    def test_toy_transition_counts_use_origins_and_destinations_in_correct_order(self):
        states = daily([1, 1, 0, 1, 2, 2, 1, 0, 0, 1], dtype="Int64")
        counts = count_transitions(states)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(counts, [[1, 2, 0], [2, 1, 1], [0, 1, 1]])
        self.assertTrue(np.issubdtype(counts.dtype, np.integer))
        self.assertEqual(int(counts.sum()), len(states) - 1)

    def test_missing_states_are_not_bridged_and_unused_labels_keep_their_rows(self):
        states = daily([1, pd.NA, 0, 1, pd.NA, 2], dtype="Int64")
        expected = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=int)
        expected[0, 1] = 1
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(count_transitions(states), expected)

    def test_invalid_state_labels_are_rejected(self):
        for invalid in [-1, 3, 0.5, np.inf, "invalid"]:
            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    count_transitions(daily([0, invalid, 1]))

    def test_first_passage_matches_independent_exact_path_enumeration(self):
        F = Fraction
        probabilities = [[F(1, 3), F(2, 3), F(0)],
                         [F(1, 2), F(1, 4), F(1, 4)],
                         [F(0), F(1, 2), F(1, 2)]]
        matrix = np.array(probabilities, dtype=float)
        for horizon in [0, 1, 2, 5]:
            result = first_passage_probabilities(matrix, horizon=horizon)
            self.assertEqual(result.name, "hit_probability")
            self.assertEqual(result.index.tolist(), [1, 2])
            for initial in [1, 2]:
                probability = F(0)
                for future in product(range(3), repeat=horizon):
                    if 0 in future:
                        path = (initial,) + future
                        probability += prod(probabilities[a][b] for a, b in zip(path[:-1], path[1:]))
                self.assertAlmostEqual(result.loc[initial], float(probability), places=14)

    def test_first_hit_differs_from_endpoint_and_q_is_not_renormalized(self):
        matrix = np.array([[1 / 3, 2 / 3, 0], [.5, .25, .25], [0, .5, .5]])
        result = first_passage_probabilities(matrix, horizon=5)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result.to_numpy(), [431 / 512, 175 / 256])
        endpoints = np.linalg.matrix_power(matrix, 5)[1:, 0]
        self.assertTrue((result.to_numpy() > endpoints).all())
        # Changing behavior AFTER a first hit cannot alter first-hit probabilities.
        modified = matrix.copy()
        modified[0] = [1, 0, 0]
        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(result, first_passage_probabilities(modified, horizon=5))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(first_passage_probabilities(matrix, horizon=1), [.5, 0.0])

    def test_invalid_probability_matrices_and_horizons_are_rejected(self):
        valid = np.array([[.2, .5, .3], [1, 0, 0], [.5, 0, .5]])
        for invalid in [np.ones((2, 2)), np.ones((3, 3)),
                        np.array([[-.1, .6, .5], [1, 0, 0], [.5, 0, .5]]),
                        np.full((3, 3), np.nan), np.full((3, 3), np.inf)]:
            with self.subTest(matrix=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    first_passage_probabilities(invalid)
        for horizon in [-1, 1.5, True, False, "5"]:
            with self.subTest(horizon=horizon):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    first_passage_probabilities(valid, horizon=horizon)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(first_passage_probabilities(valid, horizon=0), [0, 0])



class EventLabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_event_excludes_current_state_and_status_precedence_is_explicit(self):
        states = daily([0, pd.NA, 1, 2, 0, 1], dtype="Int64")
        result = make_event_labels(states, horizon=1)
        expected_target = pd.Series([pd.NA, pd.NA, 0, 1, pd.NA, pd.NA],
                                    index=states.index, name="target", dtype="Int64")
        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(result["target"], expected_target)
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].tolist(),
                         ["risk_origin", "origin_missing", "available", "available",
                          "risk_origin", "incomplete_future"])
        # A risk origin remains excluded even if its next state is missing.
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].iloc[0], "risk_origin")

    def test_day_five_is_included_and_day_six_is_excluded(self):
        on_day_five = make_event_labels(daily([1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 0, 2], dtype="Int64"))
        on_day_six = make_event_labels(daily([1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 0], dtype="Int64"))
        self.assertEqual(on_day_five["target"].iloc[0], 1)
        self.assertEqual(on_day_six["target"].iloc[0], 0)
        self.assertEqual(on_day_six["target"].iloc[1], 1)
        self.assertEqual(on_day_five["target_end_date"].iloc[0], pd.Timestamp("2020-01-06"))

    def test_early_hit_does_not_make_an_incomplete_future_available(self):
        states = daily([1, 0, 2], dtype="Int64")
        result = make_event_labels(states)
        self.assertTrue(pd.isna(result["target"].iloc[0]))
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].iloc[0], "incomplete_future")
        self.assertEqual(result["target_end_date"].iloc[0], pd.Timestamp("2020-01-06"))
        self.assertNotEqual(result["target_end_date"].iloc[0], states.index[1])
        self.assertTrue(result["target"].isna().all())

    def test_missing_state_inside_full_calendar_window_invalidates_even_an_early_hit(self):
        states = daily([1, 0, pd.NA, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2], dtype="Int64")
        result = make_event_labels(states)
        self.assertTrue(pd.isna(result["target"].iloc[0]))
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].iloc[0], "incomplete_future")
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].iloc[2], "origin_missing")
        # The missing date must not be skipped to collect five observed states.
        self.assertEqual(result["target"].iloc[3], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].iloc[3], "available")

    def test_schema_index_and_theoretical_end_dates_preserve_naive_or_utc_dates(self):
        for timezone in [None, "UTC"]:
            with self.subTest(timezone=timezone):
                states = daily([1, 2, pd.NA, 0, 1, 2, 1], dtype="Int64", tz=timezone)
                result = make_event_labels(states)
                self.assertEqual(list(result.columns), ["state", "target", "target_end_date", "label_status"])
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(result.index, states.index)
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(result["state"], states.rename("state"))
                self.assertEqual(str(result["target"].dtype), "Int64")
                self.assertIsInstance(result["label_status"].dtype, pd.StringDtype)
                expected_end = pd.Series(states.index + pd.Timedelta(days=5),
                                         index=states.index, name="target_end_date")
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(result["target_end_date"], expected_end)

    def test_event_horizon_requires_a_positive_integer_excluding_bool(self):
        states = daily([1, 2, 0], dtype="Int64")
        for horizon in [0, -1, 1.5, True, False, "5", None, np.nan]:
            with self.subTest(horizon=horizon):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    make_event_labels(states, horizon=horizon)
        self.assertEqual(make_event_labels(states, horizon=1)["target"].iloc[1], 1)

    def test_event_inputs_reject_invalid_states_and_broken_daily_indexes(self):
        base = pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=3, freq="D")
        invalid_indexes = {
            "duplicate": pd.DatetimeIndex([base[0], base[0], base[2]]),
            "unsorted": pd.DatetimeIndex([base[1], base[0], base[2]]),
            "gap": pd.DatetimeIndex([base[0], base[1], base[2] + pd.Timedelta(days=1)]),
            "not_midnight": base + pd.Timedelta(hours=12),
            "not_datetime": pd.RangeIndex(3),
            "non_utc_midnight": pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=3, tz="America/New_York"),
        }
        for name, index in invalid_indexes.items():
            with self.subTest(index=name):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    make_event_labels(pd.Series([0, 1, 2], index=index))
        for invalid in [-1, 3, 0.5, np.inf, -np.inf, "invalid"]:
            with self.subTest(state=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    make_event_labels(daily([1, invalid, 2]))

    def test_as_of_mature_labels_are_unchanged_by_later_states(self):
        states = daily([1] * 20, dtype="Int64")
        states.iloc[3] = 0
        cutoff = states.index[10]
        changed = states.copy()
        changed.iloc[11] = 0
        before, after = make_event_labels(states), make_event_labels(changed)
        before_mature = before.loc[before["target"].notna() & (before["target_end_date"] <= cutoff)]
        after_mature = after.loc[after["target"].notna() & (after["target_end_date"] <= cutoff)]
        self.assertGreater(len(before_mature), 0)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(before_mature, after_mature)
        self.assertIn(states.index[5], before_mature.index)  # Ends exactly at cutoff.
        self.assertNotIn(states.index[6], before_mature.index)
        self.assertEqual(before["target"].iloc[6], 0)
        self.assertEqual(after["target"].iloc[6], 1)  # Changed label is still immature at cutoff.

    def test_all_nonrisk_futures_have_zero_targets_only_when_complete(self):
        states = daily([1, 2] * 5, dtype="Int64")
        result = make_event_labels(states)
        self.assertEqual(result["target"].iloc[:5].tolist(), [0] * 5)
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].iloc[:5].tolist(), ["available"] * 5)
        self.assertTrue(result["target"].iloc[5:].isna().all())
        self.assertEqual(result["label_status"].iloc[5:].tolist(), ["incomplete_future"] * 5)



if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Synthetic orchestration checks; execute tagged definitions, never data cells."""
import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def load_functions():
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    candidates = [here / "prepared/01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb",
                  here.parent / "notebooks/01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb"]
    path = next(candidate for candidate in candidates if candidate.is_file())
    notebook = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    trees, names = [], set()
    for index, cell in enumerate(notebook["cells"]):
        if cell.get("cell_type") != "code" or "research-functions" not in cell.get("metadata", {}).get("tags", []):
            continue
        source = cell["source"]
        tree = ast.parse("".join(source) if isinstance(source, list) else source)
        for node in tree.body:
            if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) or node.name in names:
                raise ValueError("Tagged cells must contain unique function definitions only")
            names.add(node.name)
        trees.append((index, tree))
    required = {"run_development_diagnostic", "residence_bootstrap", "holm_adjust"}
    if not required.issubset(names):
        raise ValueError("Required Part B definitions are missing")
    namespace = {"np": np, "pd": pd}
    for index, tree in trees:
        exec(compile(tree, f"{path}#cell-{index}", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace


FUNCTIONS = load_functions()
run_development_diagnostic = FUNCTIONS["run_development_diagnostic"]
residence_bootstrap = FUNCTIONS["residence_bootstrap"]
holm_adjust = FUNCTIONS["holm_adjust"]
CONFIG = {"ck_lag": 5, "max_duration": 20, "min_runs": 5,
          "n_simulations": 7, "seed": 20261004}


def states(repeats):
    return pd.Series([0, 1, 2] * repeats,
                     index=pd.date_range("2021-01-01", periods=3 * repeats, freq="D"), dtype="Int64")


class PartBAvailabilityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sparse_observed_residence_is_retained_without_simulation_and_withholds_family(self):
        path = states(4)
        simulator = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("An unavailable observed path must not be simulated"))
        with patch.dict(FUNCTIONS, {"simulate_markov_paths": simulator}):
            result = run_development_diagnostic(path, str(path.index[0].date()),
                                               str(path.index[-1].date()), "Residence", CONFIG)
        simulator.assert_not_called()
        self.assertIsNone(result["observed"])
        self.assertTrue(np.isnan(result["p_value"]))
        self.assertEqual(result["n_simulations"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["simulated_statistics"]), 0)
        self.assertIn("Too few complete runs", result["unavailable_reason"])
        family = holm_adjust(pd.Series({"CK": .01, "Residence": result["p_value"]}))
        self.assertTrue(family["holm_p"].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(family["reject"].isna().all())
        self.assertFalse(family["family_available"].any())

    def test_missing_state_or_date_records_both_diagnostics_unavailable_before_estimation(self):
        complete = states(10)
        missing_state = complete.copy()
        missing_state.iloc[7] = pd.NA
        missing_date = complete.drop(complete.index[7])
        estimator = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("An incomplete window must not reach estimation"))
        with patch.dict(FUNCTIONS, {"ck_bootstrap": estimator, "residence_bootstrap": estimator}):
            for path in [missing_state, missing_date]:
                for diagnostic in ["CK", "Residence"]:
                    with self.subTest(diagnostic=diagnostic, rows=len(path)):
                        result = run_development_diagnostic(path, "2021-01-01", "2021-01-30", diagnostic, CONFIG)
                        self.assertIsNone(result["observed"])
                        self.assertTrue(np.isnan(result["p_value"]))
                        self.assertEqual(result["n_simulations"], 0)
                        self.assertIn("complete prespecified development window", result["unavailable_reason"])
        estimator.assert_not_called()

    def test_available_path_matches_direct_result_and_unexpected_failures_propagate(self):
        path = states(10)
        wrapped = run_development_diagnostic(path, "2021-01-01", "2021-01-30", "Residence", CONFIG)
        direct = residence_bootstrap(path, max_duration=20, min_runs=5, n_simulations=7, seed=20261004)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(wrapped["simulated_statistics"], direct["simulated_statistics"])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(wrapped["observed"]["run_counts"], direct["observed"]["run_counts"])
        self.assertEqual(wrapped["p_value"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(wrapped["n_simulations"], 7)
        with patch.dict(FUNCTIONS, {"residence_bootstrap": Mock(side_effect=ValueError("unexpected implementation failure"))}):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "unexpected implementation failure"):
                run_development_diagnostic(path, "2021-01-01", "2021-01-30", "Residence", CONFIG)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
