"""Independent synthetic checks for Part A; never load market-data cells."""
import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if not (ROOT / "notebooks/01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT / "prepared"


def _load_functions():
    path = ROOT / "notebooks/01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb"
    notebook = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    required = {"make_features", "count_transitions", "first_passage_probabilities",
                "make_event_labels", "rolling_forecasts", "score_forecasts",
                "evaluate_asset", "stationary_bootstrap_indices"}
    trees, names = [], set()
    for number, cell in enumerate(notebook["cells"]):
        tags = set(cell.get("metadata", {}).get("tags", []))
        if cell.get("cell_type") != "code" or "part-a-functions" not in tags:
            continue
        source = cell["source"]
        source = source if isinstance(source, str) else "".join(source)
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=f"{path}#cell-{number}")
        for node in tree.body:
            if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
                raise ValueError("Tagged research cells may contain only function definitions")
            if node.name in names:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate function definition: {node.name}")
            names.add(node.name)
        trees.append((number, tree))
    if not required.issubset(names):
        raise ValueError(f"Missing functions: {sorted(required - names)}")
    namespace = {"np": np, "pd": pd}
    for number, tree in trees:
        exec(compile(tree, f"{path}#cell-{number}", "exec"), namespace)
    return {name: namespace[name] for name in required}


globals().update(_load_functions())
CONFIG = json.loads((ROOT / "research/part_a_config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def daily(values, *, tz=None):
    return pd.Series(values, index=pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=len(values), freq="D", tz=tz), dtype="Int64")


def state_sample():
    states = daily(np.random.default_rng(805).choice([0, 1, 2], size=600, p=[.23, .44, .33]))
    states.iloc[[35, 97, 210, 315]] = pd.NA
    return states


def manual_forecast(states, date, config):
    """Explicit date/label loops, with no calls to notebook math helpers."""
    start = date - pd.Timedelta(days=config["window_days"] - 1)
    history = states.loc[(states.index >= start) & (states.index <= date)]
    counts = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=int)
    for position in range(len(history) - 1):
        source, destination = history.iloc[position:position + 2]
        if pd.notna(source) and pd.notna(destination):
            counts[int(source), int(destination)] += 1
    labels = []
    horizon = config["horizon"]
    for position in range(len(history) - horizon):
        source = history.iloc[position]
        future = history.iloc[position + 1:position + 1 + horizon]
        if pd.notna(source) and int(source) in (1, 2) and future.notna().all():
            labels.append((history.index[position], int(source), int((future == 0).any())))
    source_counts = counts.sum(axis=1)
    group_sizes = {state: sum(source == state for _, source, _ in labels) for state in (1, 2)}
    current = states.loc[date]
    eligible = bool(pd.notna(current) and int(current) in (1, 2)
                    and counts.sum() >= config["min_pairs"]
                    and min(source_counts[1:]) >= config["min_source_pairs"]
                    and len(labels) >= config["min_labels"]
                    and min(group_sizes.values()) >= config["min_state_labels"])
    result = {
        "history_start": start, "n_pairs": int(counts.sum()),
        "n_source_1": int(source_counts[1]), "n_source_2": int(source_counts[2]),
        "n_labels": len(labels), "n_labels_1": group_sizes[1], "n_labels_2": group_sizes[2],
        "latest_label_origin": labels[-1][0] if labels else pd.NaT,
        "latest_label_end": labels[-1][0] + pd.Timedelta(days=horizon) if labels else pd.NaT,
        "eligible": eligible,
    }
    if eligible:
        smoothed = counts.astype(float) + config["dirichlet_alpha"]
        transition = smoothed / smoothed.sum(axis=1)[:, None]
        q_power = np.eye(2)
        for _ in range(horizon):
            q_power = q_power @ transition[1:, 1:]
        current_group = [target for _, source, target in labels if source == int(current)]
        alpha, beta = config["beta_alpha"], config["beta_beta"]
        result.update(q_markov=1. - q_power[int(current) - 1].sum(),
                      q_pooled=(sum(target for _, _, target in labels) + alpha) / (len(labels) + alpha + beta),
                      q_state=(sum(current_group) + alpha) / (len(current_group) + alpha + beta))
    return result


def scoring_fixture():
    index = pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=12, freq="D")
    state = pd.Series([1, 2] * 6, index=index, dtype="Int64")
    state.iloc[8] = 0
    forecasts = pd.DataFrame({"state": state,
        "q_markov": [0., 1., .25, .75, .4, .1, .8, .2, .65, .3, .55, .9],
        "q_pooled": [.5] * 12,
        "q_state": [.1, .9, .4, .7, .6, .3, .6, .4, .7, .4, .5, .8],
        "eligible": True, "exclusion_reason": "",
        "n_pairs": 300, "n_source_1": 140, "n_source_2": 100,
        "n_labels": 200, "n_labels_1": 110, "n_labels_2": 90,
        "history_start": index - pd.Timedelta(days=364),
        "latest_label_origin": index - pd.Timedelta(days=5),
        "latest_label_end": index}, index=index)
    forecasts.loc[index[[4, 8]], "eligible"] = False
    forecasts.loc[index[[4, 8]], "exclusion_reason"] = "synthetic_exclusion"
    forecasts.loc[index[[4, 8]], ["q_markov", "q_pooled", "q_state"]] = np.nan
    labels = pd.DataFrame({"state": state,
        "target": pd.Series([1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, pd.NA, pd.NA, 1, 0, 1], index=index, dtype="Int64"),
        "target_end_date": index + pd.Timedelta(days=5),
        "label_status": pd.Series(["available"] * 12, index=index, dtype="string")}, index=index)
    labels.loc[index[7], "label_status"] = "incomplete_future"
    labels.loc[index[8], "label_status"] = "risk_origin"
    config = dict(CONFIG, bootstrap_samples=31)
    return forecasts, labels, config


class PredictionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_config_records_the_agreed_values(self):
        expected = dict(horizon=5, window_days=365, dirichlet_alpha=1, beta_alpha=1,
                        beta_beta=1, min_pairs=250, min_source_pairs=20,
                        min_labels=100, min_state_labels=20, log_clip=1e-12,
                        calibration_bins=10, bootstrap_samples=2000,
                        bootstrap_mean_block=10, bootstrap_seed=20261007, ci_level=.95)
        for name, value in expected.items():
            with self.subTest(parameter=name):
                self.assertEqual(CONFIG[name], value)

    def test_rolling_forecasts_match_independent_counts_mature_labels_and_probabilities(self):
        states = state_sample()
        dates = states.index[390:405]
        actual = rolling_forecasts(states, dates[0], dates[-1], CONFIG)
        pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual.index, dates, check_names=False)
        for date in dates:
            expected = manual_forecast(states, date, CONFIG)
            with self.subTest(date=date):
                for name, value in expected.items():
                    if name.startswith("q_"):
                        self.assertAlmostEqual(actual.at[date, name], value, places=13)
                    else:
                        self.assertEqual(actual.at[date, name], value)
                if not expected["eligible"]:
                    self.assertTrue(actual.loc[date, ["q_markov", "q_pooled", "q_state"]].isna().all())

    def test_future_state_changes_leave_all_earlier_forecast_fields_unchanged(self):
        states = state_sample()
        cutoff = states.index[415]
        changed = states.copy()
        changed.loc[changed.index > cutoff] = 0
        original = rolling_forecasts(states, states.index[390], cutoff, CONFIG)
        perturbed = rolling_forecasts(changed, states.index[390], cutoff, CONFIG)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(original, perturbed)
        self.assertTrue((original["latest_label_end"].dropna() <= original["latest_label_end"].dropna().index).all())

    def test_mature_label_ends_at_origin_and_early_hit_cannot_enter_history(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2] * 200)
        origin = states.index[400]
        states.iloc[395] = 1  # The label ending exactly at the forecast origin is eligible.
        states.iloc[398] = 1
        states.iloc[399] = 0  # Early hit, but this origin's five-day label is still immature.
        result = rolling_forecasts(states, origin, origin, CONFIG).loc[origin]
        expected = manual_forecast(states, origin, CONFIG)
        self.assertEqual(result["latest_label_origin"], states.index[395])
        self.assertEqual(result["latest_label_end"], origin)
        self.assertEqual(result["n_labels"], expected["n_labels"])
        self.assertEqual(result["n_labels_1"], expected["n_labels_1"])
        changed = states.copy()
        changed.iloc[401:] = 0
        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(result, rolling_forecasts(changed, origin, origin, CONFIG).loc[origin])

    def test_window_excludes_the_cross_boundary_transition_and_older_labels(self):
        states = state_sample()
        origin = states.index[450]
        states.loc[origin] = 1
        earliest = origin - pd.Timedelta(days=364)
        before = rolling_forecasts(states, origin, origin, CONFIG)
        changed = states.copy()
        changed.loc[changed.index < earliest] = 2
        after = rolling_forecasts(changed, origin, origin, CONFIG)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(before, after)
        self.assertEqual(before.at[origin, "history_start"], earliest)
        self.assertLessEqual(before.at[origin, "n_pairs"], 364)

    def test_every_minimum_threshold_has_an_inclusive_boundary_and_shared_eligibility(self):
        states = state_sample()
        origin = states.index[450]
        states.loc[origin] = 1
        permissive = dict(CONFIG, min_pairs=1, min_source_pairs=1, min_labels=1, min_state_labels=1)
        counts = manual_forecast(states, origin, permissive)
        boundaries = {"min_pairs": counts["n_pairs"],
                      "min_source_pairs": min(counts["n_source_1"], counts["n_source_2"]),
                      "min_labels": counts["n_labels"],
                      "min_state_labels": min(counts["n_labels_1"], counts["n_labels_2"])}
        for name, boundary in boundaries.items():
            with self.subTest(parameter=name):
                allowed = rolling_forecasts(states, origin, origin, dict(permissive, **{name: boundary})).iloc[0]
                excluded = rolling_forecasts(states, origin, origin, dict(permissive, **{name: boundary + 1})).iloc[0]
                self.assertTrue(allowed["eligible"])
                self.assertTrue(allowed[["q_markov", "q_pooled", "q_state"]].notna().all())
                self.assertFalse(excluded["eligible"])
                self.assertTrue(excluded[["q_markov", "q_pooled", "q_state"]].isna().all())
                self.assertTrue(str(excluded["exclusion_reason"]))
        for current in [0, pd.NA]:
            with self.subTest(current=current):
                changed = states.copy()
                changed.loc[origin] = current
                row = rolling_forecasts(changed, origin, origin, permissive).iloc[0]
                self.assertFalse(row["eligible"])
                self.assertTrue(row[["q_markov", "q_pooled", "q_state"]].isna().all())

    def test_rolling_rejects_missing_calendar_dates_and_invalid_states(self):
        states = state_sample()
        broken = states.drop(states.index[300])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            rolling_forecasts(broken, states.index[400], states.index[410], CONFIG)
        for invalid in [-1, 3, .5, np.inf]:
            with self.subTest(state=invalid):
                changed = states.astype(object)
                changed.iloc[300] = invalid
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    rolling_forecasts(changed, states.index[400], states.index[410], CONFIG)

    def test_stationary_indices_match_seeded_restart_rule_and_calendar_continuity(self):
        n, resamples, mean_block, seed = 12, 9, 3, 73
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        expected = np.zeros((resamples, n), dtype=int)
        expected[:, 0] = rng.integers(0, n, size=resamples)
        for position in range(1, n):
            restart = rng.random(resamples) < 1 / mean_block
            fresh = rng.integers(0, n, size=resamples)
            expected[:, position] = np.where(restart, fresh, (expected[:, position - 1] + 1) % n)
        actual = stationary_bootstrap_indices(n, resamples, mean_block, seed)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, stationary_bootstrap_indices(n, resamples, mean_block, seed))
        self.assertTrue(np.issubdtype(actual.dtype, np.integer))
        self.assertTrue(((actual >= 0) & (actual < n)).all())
        continuous = stationary_bootstrap_indices(n, resamples, 1e12, seed)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(continuous, (continuous[:, :1] + np.arange(n)) % n)

    def test_score_uses_shared_rows_unclipped_brier_clipped_log_and_endpoint_bins(self):
        forecasts, labels, config = scoring_fixture()
        result = score_forecasts(forecasts, labels, config)
        daily_losses = result["daily_losses"]
        pd.testing.assert_index_equal(daily_losses.index, forecasts.index)
        common = forecasts["eligible"] & labels["target"].notna()
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(daily_losses["scorable"], common)
        y = labels.loc[common, "target"].astype(float)
        for model in ["markov", "pooled", "state"]:
            probability = forecasts.loc[common, "q_" + model]
            expected_brier = (probability - y) ** 2
            clipped = probability.clip(config["log_clip"], 1 - config["log_clip"])
            expected_log = -y * np.log(clipped) - (1 - y) * np.log1p(-clipped)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(daily_losses.loc[common, "brier_" + model], expected_brier)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(daily_losses.loc[common, "log_" + model], expected_log)
            self.assertTrue(daily_losses.loc[~common, ["brier_" + model, "log_" + model]].isna().all().all())
            summary = result["summary"].loc[model]
            self.assertEqual(summary["n"], int(common.sum()))
            self.assertAlmostEqual(summary["brier"], expected_brier.mean())
            self.assertAlmostEqual(summary["log_loss"], expected_log.mean())
            self.assertAlmostEqual(summary["event_rate"], y.mean())
            self.assertAlmostEqual(summary["mean_forecast"], probability.mean())
            bins = result["calibration"].loc[lambda frame: frame["model"] == model]
            self.assertEqual(int(bins["n"].sum()), int(common.sum()))
        self.assertEqual(daily_losses["brier_markov"].iloc[0], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(daily_losses["brier_markov"].iloc[1], 1.0)
        bins = result["calibration"].loc[lambda frame: frame["model"] == "markov"]
        self.assertGreaterEqual(int(bins.loc[np.isclose(bins["lower"], 0), "n"].sum()), 1)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(int(bins.loc[np.isclose(bins["upper"], 1), "n"].sum()), 1)
        coverage = result["coverage"].iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(coverage["calendar_origins"], 12)
        self.assertEqual(coverage["forecast_eligible"], 10)
        self.assertEqual(coverage["scorable"], 9)
        self.assertEqual(coverage["forecast_excluded"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(coverage["label_unavailable"], 1)

    def test_bootstrap_uses_one_paired_calendar_index_matrix_for_every_comparison(self):
        forecasts, labels, config = scoring_fixture()
        result = score_forecasts(forecasts, labels, config)
        losses = result["daily_losses"]
        indices = stationary_bootstrap_indices(len(forecasts), config["bootstrap_samples"],
                                               config["bootstrap_mean_block"], config["bootstrap_seed"])
        pairs = {"markov_vs_state": ("markov", "state"),
                 "markov_vs_pooled": ("markov", "pooled"),
                 "state_vs_pooled": ("state", "pooled")}
        for name, (first, baseline) in pairs.items():
            difference = (losses["brier_" + baseline] - losses["brier_" + first]).to_numpy(dtype=float)
            expected = np.array([np.nanmean(difference[draw]) for draw in indices])
            np.testing.assert_allclose(result["bootstrap"][name], expected)
            comparison = result["comparisons"].loc[name]
            self.assertAlmostEqual(comparison["delta_brier"], np.nanmean(difference))
            alpha = (1 - config["ci_level"]) / 2
            lower, upper = np.quantile(expected, [alpha, 1 - alpha])
            self.assertAlmostEqual(comparison["ci_lower"], lower)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(comparison["ci_upper"], upper)
            self.assertEqual(comparison["invalid_resamples"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(comparison["n"], 9)
            expected_decision = "supports_improvement" if lower > 0 else "supports_worse" if upper < 0 else "uncertain"
            self.assertEqual(comparison["decision"], expected_decision)

    def test_identical_forecasts_have_zero_paired_deltas_and_uncertain_decision(self):
        forecasts, labels, config = scoring_fixture()
        forecasts["q_state"] = forecasts["q_markov"]
        result = score_forecasts(forecasts, labels, config)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["bootstrap"]["markov_vs_state"], np.zeros(config["bootstrap_samples"]))
        comparison = result["comparisons"].loc["markov_vs_state"]
        self.assertEqual(comparison["delta_brier"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(comparison["ci_lower"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(comparison["ci_upper"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(comparison["decision"], "uncertain")

    def test_one_resample_with_no_scorable_dates_is_retained_and_withholds_all_intervals(self):
        forecasts, labels, config = scoring_fixture()
        config["bootstrap_samples"] = 2
        draws = np.array([np.arange(12), np.full(12, 7)])
        sampler = Mock(return_value=draws)
        with patch.dict(score_forecasts.__globals__, {"stationary_bootstrap_indices": sampler}):
            result = score_forecasts(forecasts, labels, config)
        sampler.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(result["bootstrap"].shape, (2, 3))
        self.assertTrue(result["bootstrap"].iloc[1].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(result["bootstrap"].iloc[0].notna().all())
        self.assertTrue((result["comparisons"]["invalid_resamples"] == 1).all())
        self.assertTrue(result["comparisons"][["ci_lower", "ci_upper"]].isna().all().all())
        self.assertTrue((result["comparisons"]["decision"] == "unavailable").all())

    def test_score_rejects_invalid_probabilities_targets_states_and_end_dates(self):
        forecasts, labels, config = scoring_fixture()
        for model in ["markov", "pooled", "state"]:
            for invalid in [np.nan, np.inf, -.01, 1.01]:
                with self.subTest(model=model, value=invalid):
                    changed = forecasts.copy()
                    changed.loc[changed.index[0], "q_" + model] = invalid
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        score_forecasts(changed, labels, config)
        for invalid in [2, -.5]:
            with self.subTest(target=invalid):
                changed = labels.copy()
                changed["target"] = changed["target"].astype(object)
                changed.loc[changed.index[0], "target"] = invalid
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    score_forecasts(forecasts, changed, config)
        mismatched_state = labels.copy()
        mismatched_state.loc[mismatched_state.index[0], "state"] = 2
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            score_forecasts(forecasts, mismatched_state, config)
        wrong_end = labels.copy()
        wrong_end.loc[wrong_end.index[0], "target_end_date"] += pd.Timedelta(days=1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            score_forecasts(forecasts, wrong_end, config)

    def test_evaluate_asset_preserves_causal_forecasts_when_later_prices_change(self):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(331)
        close = pd.Series(100 * np.cumprod(1 + rng.normal(.0002, .01, 550)),
                          index=pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=550, freq="D"))
        start, end = close.index[420], close.index[439]
        changed = close.copy()
        changed.loc[changed.index > end] *= 1.5
        config = dict(CONFIG, bootstrap_samples=7)
        first = evaluate_asset(close, start, end, config)
        second = evaluate_asset(changed, start, end, config)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(first["forecasts"], second["forecasts"])
        pd.testing.assert_index_equal(first["forecasts"].index, close.loc[start:end].index, check_names=False)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(first["labels"].loc[:end - pd.Timedelta(days=5)],
                                      second["labels"].loc[:end - pd.Timedelta(days=5)])
        self.assertTrue({"daily_losses", "summary", "calibration", "comparisons", "coverage", "bootstrap",
                         "forecasts", "labels"}.issubset(first))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Offline fixtures only; no Quant directory or live data access."""
import contextlib
import csv
from decimal import Decimal
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools" / "reconcile_development.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tested_development_reconciler", SCRIPT)
audit = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
sys.modules[SPEC.name] = audit
SPEC.loader.exec_module(audit)


def values(day="2020-01-01", **changes):
    row = {"date": day, "open": "100", "high": "110", "low": "90", "close": "101",
           "volume": "12.50000000", "quote_volume": "1250.5", "taker_buy_quote": "650.25"}
    row.update(changes)
    return row


class ReconciliationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        # Normalize OS aliases such as /var -> /private/var before path checks.
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name).resolve()
        self.development = self.root / "data" / "development"
        self.development.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.mentor = self.root / "mentor.csv"
        self.output = self.root / "results" / "data_audit"

    def fixtures(self, development=None, mentor=None):
        development = development or {symbol: [values()] for symbol in audit.SYMBOLS}
        mentor = mentor or {symbol: [values()] for symbol in audit.SYMBOLS}
        for symbol in audit.SYMBOLS:
            path = self.development / f"{symbol}_1d_2020-01_2023-12.csv"
            with path.open("w", newline="") as file:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(file, fieldnames=["date", *audit.FIELDS])
                writer.writeheader()
                writer.writerows(development[symbol])
        with self.mentor.open("w", newline="") as file:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(file, fieldnames=["inst", "asof", *audit.FIELDS.values()])
            writer.writeheader()
            for symbol in audit.SYMBOLS:
                for row in mentor[symbol]:
                    writer.writerow({"inst": symbol, "asof": row["date"],
                                     **{target: row[source] for source, target in audit.FIELDS.items()}})
        return audit.AuditConfig(self.development, self.mentor, self.output)

    def test_exact_decimal_equality_field_mapping_and_input_hash(self):
        development = {symbol: [values(close="101.000", volume="12.500")] for symbol in audit.SYMBOLS}
        config = self.fixtures(development=development)
        before = self.mentor.read_bytes()
        code, report, differences = audit.reconcile(config)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(differences, [])
        self.assertEqual(report["inputs"]["mentor"]["sha256"], hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest())
        self.assertEqual(report["assets"]["BTCUSDT"]["fields"]["quote_volume"]["exact_matches"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.mentor.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertFalse(self.output.exists())

    def test_date_alignment_uses_keys_not_row_positions(self):
        rows = [values("2020-01-01", close="100"), values("2020-01-02", close="200")]
        development = {s: list(reversed(rows)) for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        mentor = {s: rows for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        config = self.fixtures(development, mentor)
        self.assertEqual(audit.reconcile(config)[0], 0)
        shifted = {s: [values("2020-01-02", close="100"), values("2020-01-03", close="200")] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        config = self.fixtures(shifted, mentor)
        code, report, _ = audit.reconcile(config)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        btc = report["assets"]["BTCUSDT"]
        self.assertEqual(btc["common_dates"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(btc["fields"]["close"]["exact_mismatches"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(btc["missing_from_development"], ["2020-01-01"])
        self.assertEqual(btc["missing_from_mentor"], ["2020-01-03"])

    def test_duplicate_keys_are_reported_and_never_arbitrarily_chosen(self):
        duplicate = [values(), values(close="999")]
        config = self.fixtures(development={s: duplicate for s in audit.SYMBOLS})
        code, report, sample = audit.reconcile(config)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        btc = report["assets"]["BTCUSDT"]
        self.assertEqual(btc["coverage"]["development"]["duplicates"][0]["count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(btc["compared_unique_dates"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(btc["common_dates_excluded_due_to_duplicates"], ["2020-01-01"])
        self.assertTrue(any(row["kind"] == "duplicate_key_development" for row in sample))

    def test_future_development_or_mentor_date_rejected_before_any_numeric_conversion(self):
        for source in ("development", "mentor"):
            with self.subTest(source=source):
                rows = {s: [values(close="not-a-price")] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
                future = {s: [values("2024-01-01", close="NEVER_PARSE_ME")] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
                config = self.fixtures(future if source == "development" else rows,
                                       future if source == "mentor" else rows)
                with mock.patch.object(audit, "parse_decimal", side_effect=AssertionError("Prices must remain unconverted")):
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(audit.InputRejected, "future_date_rejected"):
                        audit.reconcile(config)
                self.assertFalse(self.output.exists())

    def test_decimal_precision_and_within_tolerance_still_reported(self):
        left = "123456789012345678901234567890.00000000000000000001"
        right = "123456789012345678901234567890.00000000000000000000"
        development = {s: [values(close=left)] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        mentor = {s: [values(close=right)] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        config = self.fixtures(development, mentor)
        code, report, sample = audit.reconcile(config)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        close = report["assets"]["BTCUSDT"]["fields"]["close"]
        self.assertEqual(close["exact_mismatches"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(close["outside_fixed_tolerance"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(Decimal(close["maximum_absolute_difference"]), Decimal("0.00000000000000000001"))
        self.assertTrue(sample[0]["within_tolerance"])
        # The aggregate must not silently round to Decimal's default 28 digits.
        fraction = "0.123456789012345678901234567890123456789"
        config = self.fixtures({s: [values(close="100" + fraction[1:])] for s in audit.SYMBOLS},
                               {s: [values(close="100")] for s in audit.SYMBOLS})
        _, report, _ = audit.reconcile(config)
        self.assertEqual(Decimal(report["assets"]["BTCUSDT"]["fields"]["close"]["sum_absolute_difference"]), Decimal(fraction))

    def test_internal_gaps_and_sol_unique_history_separate_from_listing_claims(self):
        full = [values("2020-08-11"), values("2020-08-12"), values("2020-08-13")]
        development = {s: full for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        mentor = {s: full for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        mentor["SOLUSDT"] = full[1:]
        development["BTCUSDT"] = [full[0], full[2]]
        code, report, _ = audit.reconcile(self.fixtures(development, mentor))
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(report["assets"]["BTCUSDT"]["coverage"]["development"]["gaps_within_observed_span"], ["2020-08-12"])
        sol = report["assets"]["SOLUSDT"]
        self.assertTrue(sol["summary"]["close_exact_on_compared_common_dates"])
        self.assertEqual(sol["missing_from_mentor"], ["2020-08-11"])
        self.assertEqual(sol["coverage"]["development"]["gaps_within_observed_span"], [])
        self.assertNotIn("listing_date", sol)

    def test_limited_difference_export_reports_truncation_without_changing_sources(self):
        development = {s: [values(close="102", volume="99")] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        base = self.fixtures(development=development)
        config = audit.AuditConfig(base.development_dir, base.mentor_csv, base.output_dir, 2)
        before = {p: p.read_bytes() for p in [self.mentor, *audit.input_paths(config).values()]}
        code, report, sample = audit.reconcile(config)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(sample), 2)
        self.assertEqual(report["difference_records_total"], 6)
        self.assertTrue(report["difference_sample_truncated"])
        report_path, differences_path = audit.write_report(config, report, sample)
        with differences_path.open() as file:
            self.assertEqual(len(list(csv.DictReader(file))), 2)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(report_path.read_text())["difference_records_saved"], 2)
        for path, payload in before.items():
            self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes(), payload)

    def test_no_latest_file_discovery_and_holdout_path_rejected(self):
        config = self.fixtures()
        exact = self.development / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2023-12.csv"
        latest = self.development / "BTCUSDT_1d_2020-01_2026-09.csv"
        exact.rename(latest)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(audit.InputRejected, "required_input_file_missing"):
            audit.reconcile(config)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(audit.InputRejected, "holdout_path_rejected"):
            audit.checked_path(self.root / "data" / "holdout_sealed" / "some.csv")

    def test_late_large_differences_remain_visible_after_csv_sample_is_full(self):
        days = ["2020-01-01", "2020-01-02", "2020-01-03"]
        development = {s: [values(day) for day in days] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        mentor = {s: [values(day) for day in days] for s in audit.SYMBOLS}
        development["BTCUSDT"][0]["close"] = "101.000000001"
        development["ETHUSDT"][2]["volume"] = "99"
        development["SOLUSDT"][0]["open"] = "100.01"
        development["SOLUSDT"][2]["open"] = "150"
        base = self.fixtures(development, mentor)
        config = audit.AuditConfig(base.development_dir, base.mentor_csv, base.output_dir, 1)
        code, report, sample = audit.reconcile(config)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(sample), 1)
        self.assertEqual(sample[0]["asset"], "BTCUSDT")
        self.assertEqual(report["difference_records_total"], 4)
        self.assertTrue(report["difference_sample_truncated"])
        self.assertEqual(report["assets"]["SOLUSDT"]["fields"]["open"]["largest_difference"],
                         {"date": "2020-01-03", "development_value": "150", "mentor_value": "100", "absolute_difference": "50"})
        self.assertEqual(report["assets"]["ETHUSDT"]["fields"]["volume"]["largest_difference"]["absolute_difference"], "86.50000000")
        self.assertIsNone(report["assets"]["BTCUSDT"]["fields"]["open"]["largest_difference"])

    def test_input_and_output_symlinks_rejected(self):
        config = self.fixtures()
        alias = self.root / "mentor_alias.csv"
        alias.symlink_to(self.mentor)
        unsafe = audit.AuditConfig(config.development_dir, alias, config.output_dir)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(audit.InputRejected, "symlink_path_rejected"):
            audit.reconcile(unsafe)
        destination = self.root / "actual_results"
        destination.mkdir()
        self.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.output.symlink_to(destination, target_is_directory=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(audit.InputRejected, "symlink_path_rejected"):
            audit.reconcile(config)

    def test_cli_emits_clear_input_rejection_and_no_output_for_future_data(self):
        config = self.fixtures(development={s: [values("2025-01-01")] for s in audit.SYMBOLS})
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as output:
            code = audit.main(["--development-dir", str(config.development_dir), "--mentor-csv", str(config.mentor_csv),
                               "--output-dir", str(config.output_dir)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("future_date_rejected", output.getvalue())
        self.assertFalse(config.output_dir.exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Independent synthetic residence-time and Holm checks; no market data read.

Set BTC_PART_B_NOTEBOOK to test a staged notebook. Installed in tests/, the
default loads only function definitions from the project's canonical notebook.
"""
import ast
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import groupby
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _load_notebook_functions():
    default = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "notebooks/01_states_and_first_passage.ipynb"
    path = Path(os.environ.get("BTC_PART_B_NOTEBOOK", str(default)))
    notebook = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected = {"extract_complete_runs", "residence_statistic", "residence_bootstrap", "holm_adjust", "development_window"}
    trees, names = [], set()
    for index, cell in enumerate(notebook["cells"]):
        if cell.get("cell_type") != "code" or "research-functions" not in cell.get("metadata", {}).get("tags", []):
            continue
        source = cell.get("source", [])
        source = source if isinstance(source, str) else "".join(source)
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=f"{path}#cell-{index}")
        for node in tree.body:
            if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
                raise ValueError("research-functions cells must contain only function definitions")
            if node.name in names:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate notebook function: {node.name}")
            names.add(node.name)
        trees.append((index, tree))
    if not expected.issubset(names):
        raise ValueError(f"Missing notebook functions: {sorted(expected - names)}")
    namespace = {"np": np, "pd": pd}
    # Validate all selected cells first. Never execute loading, analysis, or
    # display cells, and never inspect saved notebook outputs.
    for index, tree in trees:
        exec(compile(tree, f"{path}#cell-{index}", "exec"), namespace)
    return {name: namespace[name] for name in expected}


globals().update(_load_notebook_functions())


def daily(values, *, tz=None):
    return pd.Series(values, index=pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=len(values), freq="D", tz=tz))


def expand_runs(pairs):
    return [state for state, length in pairs for _ in range(length)]


MANUAL_RUNS = [(0, 2), (1, 1), (2, 3), (0, 2), (1, 2),
               (2, 1), (0, 1), (1, 1), (2, 2), (1, 4)]


def manual_statistic(sequence, max_duration=20, min_runs=5, fixed_matrix=None):
    """Independent loop/groupby oracle, also used to detect failure to refit."""
    values = [int(value) for value in sequence]
    counts = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=int)
    for left, right in zip(values[:-1], values[1:]):
        counts[left, right] += 1
    if (counts.sum(axis=1) == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Missing source row")
    matrix = counts / counts.sum(axis=1)[:, None]
    grouped = [(state, len(list(items))) for state, items in groupby(values)]
    complete = grouped[1:-1]
    lengths = [[length for state, length in complete if state == wanted] for wanted in range(3)]
    run_counts = np.array([len(items) for items in lengths])
    if (run_counts < min_runs).any():
        raise ValueError("Too few complete runs")
    if fixed_matrix is not None:
        matrix = fixed_matrix
    total = 0.0
    for state in range(3):
        squared_errors = []
        for duration in range(2, max_duration + 1):
            empirical = sum(length >= duration for length in lengths[state]) / len(lengths[state])
            geometric = float(matrix[state, state]) ** (duration - 1)
            squared_errors.append((empirical - geometric) ** 2)
        total += (len(lengths[state]) / len(complete)) * sum(squared_errors) / len(squared_errors)
    return float(total), counts / counts.sum(axis=1)[:, None], run_counts


class CompleteRunTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_all_runs_dates_and_boundary_flags_match_manual_oracle(self):
        states = daily(expand_runs(MANUAL_RUNS), tz="UTC")
        runs = extract_complete_runs(states)
        self.assertEqual(set(runs.columns), {"state", "length", "start_date", "end_date",
                                             "left_truncated", "right_truncated", "complete"})
        self.assertEqual(list(zip(runs["state"], runs["length"])), MANUAL_RUNS)
        offset = 0
        for position, (_, length) in enumerate(MANUAL_RUNS):
            row = runs.iloc[position]
            self.assertEqual(row["start_date"], states.index[offset])
            self.assertEqual(row["end_date"], states.index[offset + length - 1])
            self.assertEqual(bool(row["left_truncated"]), position == 0)
            self.assertEqual(bool(row["right_truncated"]), position == len(MANUAL_RUNS) - 1)
            self.assertEqual(bool(row["complete"]), 0 < position < len(MANUAL_RUNS) - 1)
            offset += length
        self.assertEqual(int(runs["length"].sum()), len(states))

    def test_one_run_is_both_left_and_right_truncated_even_for_one_observation(self):
        for length in [1, 7]:
            with self.subTest(length=length):
                runs = extract_complete_runs(daily([2] * length))
                self.assertEqual(len(runs), 1)
                self.assertEqual(int(runs.iloc[0]["length"]), length)
                self.assertTrue(bool(runs.iloc[0]["left_truncated"]))
                self.assertTrue(bool(runs.iloc[0]["right_truncated"]))
                self.assertFalse(bool(runs.iloc[0]["complete"]))

    def test_two_distinct_runs_have_no_complete_run(self):
        runs = extract_complete_runs(daily([0, 0, 1, 1, 1]))
        self.assertEqual(len(runs), 2)
        self.assertFalse(runs["complete"].any())
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(runs["left_truncated"], [True, False])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(runs["right_truncated"], [False, True])

    def test_missing_or_invalid_states_are_rejected_without_bridging(self):
        for invalid in [pd.NA, np.nan, np.inf, -1, 3, .5, "invalid"]:
            with self.subTest(value=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    extract_complete_runs(daily([0, 0, invalid, 0, 1, 2]))

    def test_missing_duplicate_unsorted_and_nondaily_dates_are_rejected(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2])
        index = states.index
        bad_indexes = [index.delete(2).append(pd.DatetimeIndex([index[-1] + pd.Timedelta(days=1)])),
                       pd.DatetimeIndex([index[0], index[0], *index[2:]]),
                       index[::-1], index + pd.Timedelta(hours=1), pd.RangeIndex(len(states))]
        for bad in bad_indexes:
            with self.subTest(index=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    extract_complete_runs(pd.Series(states.to_numpy(), index=bad))


class ResidenceStatisticTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_weighted_statistic_matches_exact_rational_hand_calculation(self):
        states = daily(expand_runs(MANUAL_RUNS))
        result = residence_statistic(states, max_duration=4, min_runs=2)
        self.assertTrue({"P1", "counts_1", "runs", "run_counts", "run_weights", "durations",
                         "empirical_survival", "geometric_survival", "statistic"}.issubset(result))
        counts = np.array([[2, 3, 0], [0, 4, 3], [2, 1, 3]])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["counts_1"], counts)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["P1"], counts / np.array([5, 7, 6])[:, None])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["run_counts"], [2, 3, 3])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["run_weights"], [2 / 8, 3 / 8, 3 / 8])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["durations"], [2, 3, 4])
        empirical = [[Fraction(1, 2), Fraction(0), Fraction(0)],
                     [Fraction(1, 3), Fraction(0), Fraction(0)],
                     [Fraction(2, 3), Fraction(1, 3), Fraction(0)]]
        diagonal = [Fraction(2, 5), Fraction(4, 7), Fraction(1, 2)]
        geometric = [[probability ** exponent for exponent in [1, 2, 3]] for probability in diagonal]
        expected = sum(Fraction(n, 8) * sum((a - b) ** 2 for a, b in zip(actual, fitted)) / 3
                       for n, actual, fitted in zip([2, 3, 3], empirical, geometric))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["empirical_survival"], np.array(empirical, dtype=float))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["geometric_survival"], np.array(geometric, dtype=float))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["statistic"], float(expected), places=14)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(result["runs"], extract_complete_runs(states))

    def test_default_duration_range_is_two_through_twenty_and_cycle_has_zero_error(self):
        result = residence_statistic(daily([0, 1, 2] * 6))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["durations"], np.arange(2, 21))
        self.assertEqual(result["empirical_survival"].shape, (3, 19))
        self.assertEqual(result["geometric_survival"].shape, (3, 19))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["run_counts"], [5, 6, 5])
        self.assertEqual(result["statistic"], 0.0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            residence_statistic(daily([0, 1, 2] * 5))

    def test_two_is_valid_max_duration_and_uses_survival_not_cdf(self):
        result = residence_statistic(daily(expand_runs(MANUAL_RUNS)), max_duration=2, min_runs=2)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["durations"], [2])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["empirical_survival"], [[.5], [1 / 3], [2 / 3]])
        expected, _, _ = manual_statistic(expand_runs(MANUAL_RUNS), max_duration=2, min_runs=2)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["statistic"], expected, places=14)

    def test_sparse_one_step_rows_or_any_sparse_complete_run_group_are_unavailable(self):
        for states, minimum in [(daily([0, 1] * 12), 1),
                                (daily([0, 1, 0, 1, 2]), 1),
                                (daily([0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 0]), 2)]:
            with self.subTest(values=states.to_list(), min_runs=minimum):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    residence_statistic(states, min_runs=minimum)

    def test_statistic_rejects_missing_states_and_gapped_calendar(self):
        values = daily([0, 1, 2] * 8)
        missing = values.astype("Int64")
        missing.iloc[5] = pd.NA
        for states in [missing, values.drop(values.index[5])]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                residence_statistic(states)

    def test_duration_and_minimum_are_integers_with_explicit_lower_bounds(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2] * 8)
        invalid_by_parameter = {"max_duration": [0, 1, -1, 2.5, True, False, "20"],
                                "min_runs": [0, -1, 1.5, True, False, "5"]}
        for name, invalids in invalid_by_parameter.items():
            for value in invalids:
                with self.subTest(parameter=name, value=value):
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        residence_statistic(states, **{name: value})
        # NumPy integer parameters remain ordinary integer values.
        result = residence_statistic(states, max_duration=np.int64(2), min_runs=np.int64(1))
        self.assertEqual(result["statistic"], 0.0)


class ResidenceBootstrapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_deterministic_cycle_counts_ties_and_returns_p_one(self):
        result = residence_bootstrap(daily([0, 1, 2] * 8), n_simulations=7, seed=321)
        self.assertEqual(result["observed"]["statistic"], 0.0)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["simulated_statistics"], np.zeros(7))
        self.assertEqual(result["invalid_simulations"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["n_simulations"], 7)
        self.assertEqual(result["exceedances"], 7)
        self.assertEqual(result["p_value"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(result["seed"], 321)

    def test_each_simulation_refits_matrix_runs_and_weights_against_loop_oracle(self):
        states = daily(expand_runs(MANUAL_RUNS) * 20)
        duration, minimum, n_simulations, seed = 7, 5, 11, 203
        observed, fitted, _ = manual_statistic(states, duration, minimum)
        uniforms = np.random.default_rng(seed).random((n_simulations, len(states) - 1))
        paths = np.empty((n_simulations, len(states)), dtype=int)
        paths[:, 0] = int(states.iloc[0])
        for row in range(n_simulations):
            for step in range(1, len(states)):
                cumulative = np.cumsum(fitted[paths[row, step - 1]])
                cumulative[-1] = 1.0
                paths[row, step] = np.searchsorted(cumulative, uniforms[row, step - 1], side="right")
        expected = np.array([manual_statistic(path, duration, minimum)[0] for path in paths])
        incorrectly_fixed = np.array([manual_statistic(path, duration, minimum, fixed_matrix=fitted)[0]
                                      for path in paths])
        self.assertGreater(float(np.max(np.abs(expected - incorrectly_fixed))), 1e-5)
        result = residence_bootstrap(states, max_duration=duration, min_runs=minimum,
                                     n_simulations=n_simulations, seed=seed)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["observed"]["statistic"], observed, places=14)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["simulated_statistics"], expected, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-14)
        self.assertEqual(result["invalid_simulations"], 0)
        exceedances = int((expected >= observed).sum())
        self.assertEqual(result["exceedances"], exceedances)
        self.assertEqual(result["p_value"], (1 + exceedances) / (n_simulations + 1))
        repeat = residence_bootstrap(states, max_duration=duration, min_runs=minimum,
                                     n_simulations=n_simulations, seed=seed)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["simulated_statistics"], repeat["simulated_statistics"])

    def test_any_invalid_path_is_retained_without_drop_redraw_or_partial_p(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2] * 8)
        sparse_runs = np.repeat([0, 1, 2], 8)  # All source rows exist; complete runs are insufficient.
        absent_rows = np.zeros(len(states), dtype=int)
        paths = np.array([states.to_numpy(dtype=int), sparse_runs, absent_rows])
        simulator = Mock(return_value=paths)
        with patch.dict(residence_bootstrap.__globals__, {"simulate_markov_paths": simulator}):
            result = residence_bootstrap(states, n_simulations=3, seed=77)
        simulator.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(result["n_simulations"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(result["invalid_simulations"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["simulated_statistics"].shape, (3,))
        self.assertEqual(result["simulated_statistics"][0], 0.0)
        self.assertTrue(np.isnan(result["simulated_statistics"][1:]).all())
        self.assertTrue(np.isnan(result["p_value"]))
        self.assertIsNone(result["exceedances"])

    def test_bootstrap_validates_simulation_count_and_seed(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2] * 8)
        for name, invalids in {"n_simulations": [0, -1, 1.5, True, "3"],
                               "seed": [-1, 1.5, True, "17"]}.items():
            for value in invalids:
                arguments = {"n_simulations": 3, "seed": 17, name: value}
                with self.subTest(parameter=name, value=value):
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        residence_bootstrap(states, **arguments)


class HolmTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unsorted_values_preserve_labels_use_stepdown_monotonicity_and_clip(self):
        raw = pd.Series([.04, .008, .03, .8], index=["fourth", "first", "third", "second"], name="input")
        result = holm_adjust(raw)
        self.assertEqual(set(result.columns), {"raw_p", "holm_p", "reject", "family_available"})
        pd.testing.assert_index_equal(result.index, raw.index)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["raw_p"], raw)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["holm_p"], [.09, .032, .09, .8])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["reject"].to_numpy(dtype=bool), [False, True, False, False])
        self.assertTrue(result["family_available"].all())
        clipped = holm_adjust(pd.Series([.7, .8, 1.], index=["a", "b", "c"]))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(clipped["holm_p"], [1., 1., 1.])

    def test_ties_have_equal_adjusted_values_and_exact_alpha_boundary_rejects(self):
        raw = pd.Series([.025, .025], index=["CK", "residence"])
        result = holm_adjust(raw, alpha=.05)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["holm_p"], [.05, .05])
        self.assertTrue(result["reject"].all())
        result = holm_adjust(raw, alpha=.049)
        self.assertFalse(result["reject"].any())

    def test_zero_and_one_are_valid_probabilities(self):
        result = holm_adjust(pd.Series([1., 0.], index=["CK", "residence"]))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["holm_p"], [1., 0.])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["reject"].to_numpy(dtype=bool), [False, True])

    def test_missing_p_withholds_entire_family_without_shrinking_or_false_decisions(self):
        for raw in [pd.Series([.001, np.nan], index=["CK", "residence"]),
                    pd.Series([pd.NA, .001], index=["CK", "residence"], dtype="Float64")]:
            with self.subTest(values=raw.to_list()):
                result = holm_adjust(raw)
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(result.index, raw.index)
                self.assertTrue(result["holm_p"].isna().all())
                self.assertTrue(result["reject"].isna().all())
                self.assertEqual(str(result["reject"].dtype), "boolean")
                self.assertFalse(result["family_available"].any())
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["raw_p"].isna(), raw.isna())



class DevelopmentWindowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fixed_window_preserves_precomputed_states(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2, 1, 0, 2])
        actual = development_window(states, "2020-01-02", "2020-01-05")
        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, states.iloc[1:5])

    def test_holdout_or_incomplete_window_is_rejected(self):
        states = daily([0, 1, 2, 1, 0, 2])
        for start, end in [("2020-01-01", "2024-01-01"),
                           ("2019-12-31", "2020-01-03"),
                           ("2020-01-01", "2020-01-07")]:
            with self.subTest(start=start, end=end), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                development_window(states, start, end)
        states.iloc[2] = np.nan
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            development_window(states, "2020-01-01", "2020-01-06")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
